The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do - Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
- Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
- Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
- Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
- Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
- Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
- Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
- Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.

What we are looking for - A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
- Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
- Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.

- A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.

How we work
We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers - A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
- Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
- Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
- The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
- Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

Weâre looking for a Customer Support Specialist to join our team.

What Youâll Be Doing

Troubleshooting problems

Improving our help content

Using our support tools

- Use tools such as Front, Recurly, Customer.io, HubSpot and other internal systems to manage customer conversations, billing questions and account information. We don't expect you to know all of these already, but you should be comfortable learning new software quickly.

- Using support tools such as Front, Intercom, Zendesk, HubSpot or similar
- Working in a fully remote team
- Recording short customer help videos or walkthroughs
- Supporting customers across multiple time zones, especially APAC-friendly hours
- Comfortable using AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of your work

Working Hours

This is a remote role, for people based in either the UK or Canada (Atlantic Time Zone only). Youâll also need regular overlap with the UK team for training, collaboration and handovers.

The exact working pattern will depend on your location and the coverage we agree, but you should be clear in your application about where youâre based and what working hours you would expect to keep.

â Our Hiring Process

- Offer! â¨

â­ï¸ What Weâre Offering

- Work from anywhere you like - co-working space will be provided if necessary

description:

- 7+ years of experience in Java/JEE development , including 3+ years on CoreMedia (Content Cloud / CMS, Studio, CAE, Headless Server, Blueprint).

- Strong expertise in Java, Spring / Spring Boot, Maven , Freemarker/JSP templating and JavaScript / TypeScript .

- Solid experience designing REST and GraphQL APIs and headless / hybrid CMS architectures .

- Proven experience as Tech Lead or Lead Developer : technical decision-making, architecture, code review and mentoring.

- Experience integrating a CMS with e-commerce platforms, PIM, DAM and search solutions in a complex enterprise landscape.

- Good knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker/Kubernetes and a cloud provider (AWS, Azure or GCP).

- Good understanding of performance, caching, security, SEO and accessibility for large-scale web platforms.

- Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum, SAFe) with Jira and Confluence .

- Strong communication skills and ability to work with technical teams, business stakeholders and clients , in onsite and distributed setups.

- Fluent English (C2).

- Knowledge of e-commerce platforms or marketplaces (e.g. SAP Commerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, commercetools ).

- Front-end / headless experience ( React, Next.js, Node.js ).

- Experience with observability and performance testing tools (e.g. Grafana, Datadog, JMeter).

- Experience in large-scale Agile organisations and SAFe ceremonies such as PI Planning.

- Experience with collaboration tools such as Miro or equivalent.

- French is a strong asset (working proficiency appreciated).

- Consulting experience and a strong continuous improvement mindset .

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn. 

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people 

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. description:
Key Account Manager – New Business (m/w/d) | Retail & Brand Signage 
Full-time (40 hours per week), Hybrid (Berlin, Germany)

About Us 
At The Global Talent Co., we provide opportunities to work with leading innovative technology companies worldwide, offering stable employment, competitive compensation, career growth, and access to a community of 25,000+ like-minded marketing professionals.

About the Company 
You’ll be joining a Berlin-headquartered company that has spent over a decade becoming one of Europe’s go-to partners for premium custom signage. Its work appears in flagship stores, showrooms, hotels and offices for well-known brands in retail, luxury, automotive, hospitality and tech. Clients come back for repeat orders and multi-location rollouts, and the team is now building a dedicated new business function to match that reputation.

The Role 
As Key Account Manager – New Business, you’ll open doors with enterprise brands across Germany and Europe and turn first conversations into signed signage projects. This is a hunter role: no inherited book. Once a client signs, an experienced internal team handles all delivery, so your time goes into pipeline, new accounts and growing relationships.

You’ll work directly with the founder-led leadership team and have real autonomy over your approach. You probably work at a brand experience or shopper marketing agency, a POS or visual merchandising supplier, a Ladenbau or Messebau company, an event agency, or a large-format print house today. You enjoy getting in front of brand and retail marketing decision-makers and want a product that sells itself once you’re in the room.

Key Responsibilities 

- Identify and win new enterprise brand accounts, from first outreach to signed contract

- Build relationships with Heads of Brand, Retail Marketing, Visual Merchandising and senior marketing leaders

- Navigate buying processes involving marketing, retail operations and procurement

- Scope signage projects with clients and brief the internal team clearly from day one

- Lead pricing negotiations and shape deal structures that protect margin

- Grow accounts through repeat orders, upsell and multi-location rollouts

- Keep your pipeline clean and up to date in the CRM

- Represent the company at selected trade fairs and events such as EuroShop

Ideal Candidate 

- 2+ years in new business, key account or sales roles, selling to senior decision-makers on high-value deals

- Native-level German and professional English; based in or able to work hybrid from Berlin

- A genuine hunter: you build pipeline from scratch and are driven by ambitious goals

- A track record of opening doors and building a network among brand, marketing or retail contacts

- Structured pipeline management and CRM discipline that keeps complex deals moving

- Commercial acumen: you think in margins, pricing and deal structures, not just revenue

- You listen first and understand what really matters to a client before you pitch

- Mature, confident and energising to work with

Nice to Have 

- A background in brand experience, retail or shopper marketing agencies, POS and visual merchandising, Ladenbau, Messebau, event agencies with retail or gastro clients, or large-format production

- Hands-on experience with tenders, RFPs and framework agreements

- An existing network among brand, retail marketing or visual merchandising leaders in DACH

- Experience using trade fairs as a lead generation channel

title: Werkstudent:in Landwirtschaft und betriebliche Datenprüfung (all genders) (Berlin I DE Remote möglich)
description:
Please note: This job description is written in German as the role requires fluency in German and active collaboration with German-speaking stakeholders. We want to ensure clarity around expectations and language needs from the start.

Startdatum: ab 07.09.2026 - Befristet bis 28.02.2027 

Bei Klim arbeiten wir mit Landwirten und Lebensmittelunternehmen zusammen, um regenerative Landwirtschaft skalierbar und für Landwirte finanziell attraktiv zu gestalten. Über unsere Plattform unterstützen wir Landwirte dabei, die Bodengesundheit wiederherzustellen, die Artenvielfalt zu fördern und CO₂ zu binden – und gleichzeitig neue, verlässliche Einnahmequellen zu erschließen.

Als Berliner AgriTech-Startup – unterstützt durch eine Series-A-Finanzierung in Höhe von 22 Millionen US-Dollar – arbeiten wir mit führenden globalen Lebensmittelunternehmen wie Nestlé und Kaufland zusammen. Gemeinsam reduzieren wir Emissionen in deren Lieferketten und stärken die langfristige Resilienz. Seit 2020 haben wir bereits 3.500 Landwirte unterstützt, die zusammen mehr als 900.000 Hektar bewirtschaften.

Wenn du dich für ein nachhaltiges Ernährungssystem und echten Klimaschutz begeisterst, komm zu uns und hilf mit, einen gesünderen Planeten zu schaffen!

Deine Mission 

Klim begleitet Landwirt:innen und Unternehmen bei der Umstellung auf regenerative Landwirtschaft. Klim hat eine digitale Plattform entwickelt, die den Betrieben eine einfache Möglichkeit bietet, ihre regenerativen Maßnahmen zu dokumentieren, Finanzierungen für ihre umgesetzten Maßnahmen zu erhalten und vom Fachwissen einer engagierten Community zu profitieren. Gemeinsam mit landwirtschaftlichen Betrieben und teilnehmenden Unternehmen setzt sich Klim mit dieser Arbeit dafür ein, den CO2-Ausstoß in der Landwirtschaft nachhaltig zu reduzieren, die Bodengesundheit zu verbessern und Artenvielfalt zu fördern. Um Qualität und Integrität der Arbeit sicherzustellen, hat Klim einen eigenen Monitoring, Reporting und Verifizierungsprozess (MRV) entwickelt.

Als Teil unseres MRV (Monitoring, Reporting and Verification)-Teams stellst du in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren landwirtschaftlichen Partnerbetrieben die Qualität und Transparenz unserer Ergebnisse sicher.

Deine Aufgaben 

- Du arbeitest als Werkstudent:in in unserem Verifizierungsteam. Deine Aufgabe besteht in der Prüfung von Betriebsdaten hinsichtlich der umgesetzten Maßnahmen der Betriebe.

- Du durchsichtest sorgfältig Betriebsdokumenten wie Agraranträge, Ackerschlagkartei, Düngebedarfsermittlungen, Saatgutbelege, Dienstleistungsrechnungen und Inventarlisten und überprüfst, dass die Datenlage auf unserer Plattform in Einklang mit der Dokumentation steht.

- Mit deinem agrarwissenschaftlichen Fachwissen prüfst du die Plausibilität von den eingesetzten regenerativen Maßnahmen, wie Fruchtfolgen, Düngemittelverwendung und Bodenbearbeitung.

- Du stehst in engem Kontakt mit landwirtschaftlichen Betrieben zur Klärung von Fragen.

- Mit deiner Arbeit stellst du sicher, dass die von unserem Modell berechneten CO₂-Einspeicherungen und Einsparungen tatsächlich erreicht wurden.

Dein Profil 

- Du bist aktuell als Student:in an einer deutschen Universität eingeschrieben, vorzugsweise in Agrarwissenschaften, Umweltwissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich – oder bringst praktische Erfahrungen in der Landwirtschaft mit, z.B. durch persönlichen Hintergrund

- Du bringst großes Interesse an regenerativer Landwirtschaft und nachhaltigen Lösungen mit.

- Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu und hast Freude an der direkten Kommunikation mit landwirtschaftlichen Betrieben – telefonisch und per E-Mail.

- Selbstständiges, strukturiertes und verantwortungsbewusstes Arbeiten sind für dich selbstverständlich.

- Du bist versiert im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Du sprichst fließend Deutsch in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

Deine Benefits

- Growth : Einblicke in alle Arbeitsbereiche eines agilen Start-Ups und wertvolles Wissen über die moderne Arbeitswelt.

- Opportunity : Arbeite bei einem innovativen Unternehmen für regenerative Landwirtschaft und gestalte aktiv mit, wie wir unsere Ziele erreichen.

- Impact : Dein Engagement trägt täglich zur Zukunftssicherheit der Landwirtschaft, zur Bodengesundheit und zum Klimaschutz bei.

- Autonomy : Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum.

- Flexibles Arbeitsmodell : Wir fördern flexibles, hybrides Arbeiten und ermöglichen es dir, aus unserem Berliner Büro oder remote zu arbeiten.

- Weitere Benefits für Mitarbeiter:innen in Deutschland: Wir bieten eine Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club oder das Deutschlandticket, Team-Lunches (in Berlin) sowie regelmäßige Team-Events.

Wir freuen uns auf Dich! 

Bei Klim sind wir überzeugt, dass ein lebendiger und erfolgreicher Arbeitsplatz auf den vielfältigen Hintergründen, Talenten und Perspektiven unseres Teams basiert. Gemeinsam werden wir stärker, indem wir die individuellen Stärken jeder einzelnen Person wertschätzen und weiterentwickeln.

Wir setzen uns für ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld ein, in dem sich alle geschätzt fühlen und die Möglichkeit haben, ihr volles Potenzial einzubringen. Alle Einstellungs- und Personalentscheidungen treffen wir ausschließlich auf Grundlage von Qualifikationen, Leistung und den Bedürfnissen des Unternehmens – und gewährleisten so Fairness und Chancengleichheit für alle.

Wenn dich diese Position begeistert, du aber nicht jede einzelne Anforderung erfüllst, ermutigen wir dich dennoch, dich zu bewerben. Vielleicht passt du auf eine Weise perfekt zu unserem Team, die du dir noch gar nicht vorstellen kannst!

title: Senior Tax Manager (gn)
description:
Your mission The Bikeleasing Group continues to grow and is expanding its international tax function. As a Senior Tax Manager (gn), your initial focus will be on our tax matters in Germany. At the same time, you will have the opportunity to develop international topics and structures together with the relevant stakeholders. Close collaboration with external tax advisory firms, specialist departments, authorities and our parent company will be part of your daily work. The position can be performed remotely from anywhere in Germany and includes occasional business travel. Sounds good? Then we look forward to getting to know you.
Your tasks 
- You will manage the Bikeleasing Group’s tax matters independently, initially with a focus on Germany and increasingly on international topics in the future
- You will prepare tax returns, tax declarations, input tax refund claims and withholding tax applications carefully and on time
- You will be responsible for tax calculations in accordance with the German Commercial Code (HGB) as well as the IFRS reporting package for our parent company
- You will continuously monitor, document and optimise intra-group transfer pricing
- You will actively contribute your expertise to VAT-related matters and tax audits
- As the central point of contact for specialist departments, external tax advisory firms and authorities, you will provide clarity on complex tax matters
- You will further develop international tax topics and tax processes together with the relevant stakeholders

Your profile - A completed degree in business administration, economics or law with a focus on taxation, or a comparable qualification
- At least five years of professional experience in the tax department of a company or at an auditing or tax advisory firm
- In-depth knowledge of German tax law and, ideally, international tax law
- Practical experience with accounting in accordance with the German Commercial Code (HGB) and, ideally, knowledge of IFRS
- Familiarity with group structures and the related accounting requirements
- A successfully completed German tax consultant examination is desirable
- A structured and precise approach to work, as well as confidence when dealing with authorities and external partners

Why us? Around your working day - Flexible working hours and flexitime help you balance work and private life.
- Workation: Once a year, you can work remotely from another EU country—or from a country where you hold a valid work permit—for up to three weeks.
- You’ll receive modern equipment for working both in the office and remotely.
- Clear vision at work matters to us. If you need prescription glasses for your workplace, we’ll contribute €100 towards the cost.
- You’ll benefit from a wide range of training opportunities and a transparent process to support your professional and personal development.
- A summer party and regular team events give you the chance to connect and share experiences.
More for life - Every month, you’ll receive a €50 non-cash benefit voucher—for example, to spend on corporate fitness, groceries, DIY stores, fuel or online shopping.
- For your birthday, you’ll receive a €60 voucher that can be redeemed with the same providers.
- You’ll receive a €40 contribution towards capital-forming benefits.
- You can take out an occupational pension plan with our partner, ERGO.
- After your probationary period, you can lease up to two bicycles, e-bikes or pedelecs through us.
- Parents receive up to five fully paid child-sick days per child each year, up to a maximum of 12 days per year.
- We grant up to two days of special leave for certain life events.
- With Bike2future, you get 10% off used bikes and leasing offers, plus two weeks to test the bikes you choose. With a subscription, the first four weeks are free and the €99 setup fee is waived.
- Through Corporate Benefits and exclusive employee discounts, you’ll enjoy attractive offers from a wide range of partners.

title: Senior QA Engineer (gn)
description:
Your mission The Bikeleasing Group has grown into a leading corporate group for employer benefits and mobility solutions. It consists of five specialized companies, including a multi-benefit provider, leasing and insurance service providers, as well as a retailer for refurbished bikes. With our continued profitable growth and expansion, we’re on an exciting technical transformation journey. That’s why we’re looking for you as a Senior QA Engineer (gn) . In this role, you actively help shape and drive our technology ecosystem forward. We work according to Clean Code & Clean Architecture principles, give you room to experiment, and offer flexible working hours and remote work. Sounds good? We’re looking forward to your application!

- You are responsible for all aspects of the testing process in an agile feature team — of course never alone, but always together with your colleagues
- You implement best practices in test case creation, test automation, as well as test documentation and test case management
- You automate test cases using Kotlin, and in most cases with the Serenity BDD framework
- You contribute to architectural decisions regarding our test automation setup
- You take part in code reviews and technical discussions

Your profile - You have at least 5 years of experience in software testing with a focus on test automation, and ideally have ISTQB knowledge/certification
- You are proficient in object-oriented approaches to test automation and have experience with Kotlin or Java, plus the willingness to learn Kotlin
- You have hands-on experience with frontend and backend testing (web and REST). Ideally, you’ve worked with Serenity BDD or other Selenium-based frameworks, and you’re also familiar with Rest Assured
- You can independently carry out manual testing, including test management, and you understand the basics of CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
- You have strong English skills (working language) and speak German at least at B2 level for communication with stakeholders

Why us? We live team spirit: you matter to us. Every day, our constantly growing, dynamic team achieves great things — and we want you by our side

- A modern tech environment: Kotlin and TypeScript; frameworks such as Spring Boot, Vue.js, React, NestJS, Symfony; AWS cloud infrastructure fully provisioned with Terraform; and AI tooling like Claude and Copilot
- Solid technical equipment: you can choose your operating system (Windows or macOS)
- Learning & development: with our shared Udemy account, you can take trainings — and you’ll also get dedicated time to focus on your development. We also regularly attend tech conferences
- Internal tech talks: take part in our in-house sessions to stay up to date and keep learning.
- Maximum flexibility: flexible working hours, remote work, and workations
- Probonio benefit: via Probonio, you’ll receive a €50 voucher every month which you can choose freely. On your birthday, you’ll receive an additional €60 once per year
- Great insurance conditions: especially for your company pension scheme, plus capital-forming benefits
- Bikeleasing: of course, you can lease up to two bikes or pedelecs through us as your employer — with a price range from €649 to €15,000.

We see diversity as an enrichment for our team. That’s why we welcome all applications and especially encourage people with disabilities or other challenges to apply.

title: Senior PR Manager (m/w/d) – Remote oder Berlin
description:
Overview PR steht vor einem strukturellen Bruch. Vertrauen verschiebt sich, Sichtbarkeit wird neu verteilt, KI wächst exponentiell. Wir bei getpress glauben, dass Reputation in den nächsten zehn Jahren der entscheidende Wettbewerbsvorsprung für Unternehmen wird. Und dass die Agentur, die das ernst nimmt, anders aussehen muss als die Agentur von gestern. 
Deshalb bauen wir die PR Company der Zukunft . Outcome-getrieben statt Retainer-Stunden. KI-first statt KI-on-top. Automatisiert, wo es skaliert und menschlich, wo es wirklich zählt. Unser über 40 köpfiges Team aus Journalist*innen und PR-Strateg*innen hat seit 2017 die PR für 450+ der spannendsten Wachstumsunternehmen Europas gesteuert – und hat Hunger auf mehr. 
Bist du dabei? 

Deine Rolle - Strategisch und themensicher: Du entwickelst individuelle PR Strategien für Kunden aus dem B2B- und B2C-Bereich – mit klarem Fokus auf Themenplatzierung in relevanten Medien. Dabei bringst du journalistisches Denken und strategische Kommunikation zusammen. 
- Beratend auf Augenhöhe: Du steuerst die Kommunikation mit deinen Kund*innen professionell, planst vorausschauend (z. B. mit Quartalsplänen & KPIs) und baust langfristige Beziehungen auf. Du bringst proaktiv Themen ein – und entwickelst die Kommunikation deiner Kund*innen kontinuierlich weiter. Du bist Sparringspartner*in auf C-Level-Augenhöhe, nicht Auftragsempfänger*in. 
- Teamorientiert & offen: Du teilst dein Wissen, gibst und nimmst Peer-to-Peer-Feedback über alle Erfahrungslevel hinweg, ohne Gatekeeping, mit echtem Interesse an gemeinsamer Weiterentwicklung. 
- Vorne auf der AI Welle: Du arbeitest aktiv mit unserem internen AI-Stack. Recherche, Pitch-Vorbereitung, Themen-Scouting – wo Maschinen schneller sind, lassen wir sie machen. Du investierst die gewonnene Zeit in Substanz, Beziehungen und Kreativität. 
- Aktives Netzwerken: Du baust und pflegst belastbare Beziehungen zu Journalist*innen aus den wichtigsten Medien im DACH Raum und Europas. 

Wer du bist - 4+ Jahre Erfahrung in der operativen PR, idealerweise im Agenturumfeld, und hast Kund*innen nachweislich eigenständig in deutschen Leit- und Fachmedien platziert. 
- Du bringst fundierte Beratungskompetenz mit, analysierst Zielgruppen und Märkte, übersetzt Unternehmensziele in PR Strategien, leitest messbare Maßnahmen ab und begleitest deine Kund*innen als verlässliche* Sparringspartner*in auf Augenhöhe. 
- Du hast ein belastbares Netzwerk zu Journalist*innen und weißt, wie man vertrauensvolle Beziehungen aufbaut und pflegt. 
- Du beobachtest die Nachrichtenlage aktiv und erkennst Themenpotenziale, bevor andere sie auf dem Schirm haben. 
- Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, bringst dich ins Team ein und teilst dein Wissen offen. 
- Du nutzt KI-Tools pragmatisch, um Prozesse zu beschleunigen, damit mehr Zeit für inhaltliche Tiefe und kreative Ideen bleibt. 
- Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2- Niveau, kannst auch auf Englisch professionell kommunizieren und lebst in Deutschland 

Was dich erwartet - Journalistische PR statt Massenversand: Bei uns gibt es keine generischen Pressemitteilungen oder Gießkannenverteiler. Wir arbeiten individuell, redaktionell und mit klarer Themenstrategie und pitchen gezielt per Telefon bei passenden Journalist*innen aus einem breiten Medienspektrum. 
- Langfristige Perspektive & Entwicklung: Du startest mit einem unbefristeten Vertrag. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir einen klaren Fahrplan für deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung – mit regelmäßigen Feedbacks und transparenten Zielen. 
- Flexibilität, die wirklich gelebt wird: Ob remote (innerhalb Deutschlands), hybrid oder im Berliner Office – wir ermöglichen Arbeitsmodelle, die sich mit deinem privaten und beruflichen Leben gut vereinbaren lassen. Entscheidungsfreiheit, Eigenverantwortung und klare Kommunikation gehören für uns selbstverständlich dazu. 
- Unterstützung und offene Arme: Wir begegnen einander auf Augenhöhe – offen, ehrlich und mit echtem Interesse am Gegenüber. Wir lernen voneinander, geben einander Rückhalt und feiern gemeinsame Erfolge. 
- Eine Kultur von Challengern. Wir arbeiten ergebnisgetrieben, feiern Erfolge und erwarten, dass du uns challenged – und wir challengen zurück. Augenhöhe heißt bei uns: ehrliches Feedback in beide Richtungen. 
- Eine Lernkurve, die du anderswo nicht bekommst. Du arbeitest täglich mit einem Team, das das fortschrittlichste AI PR System im Markt baut. Wer sich jetzt einbringt, baut sich ein Profil, das in der Branche selten ist. 
- Benefits und Sweet Treats: Du kannst aus drei frei wählbaren Sachbezügen wählen, von einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge mit 20% Zuschuss auf deine Einzahlungen profitieren,180 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland arbeiten, dich auf regelmäßige Teamevents freuen. Und das Beste: Du startest mit 27 Urlaubstagen aber je länger du bei uns bist, desto mehr Urlaubstage bekommst du dazu. 

Unser nächsten Schritte Wenn du jetzt denkst: ,,Klingt nach mir!’’ , dann bewirb dich ohne Anschreiben bei uns und wer weiß, vielleicht bist du schon schneller als gedacht Teil unseres getpress-Teams!

Wir setzen uns für Chancengleichheit ein und begrüßen Bewerbungen von Menschen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Orientierung, Alter oder Behinderung. 

Wir freuen uns dich kennenzulernen! 
Dein People & Culture Team

title: Backend Engineer - Agentic AI (m/w/d)
description:
Overview getpress entwickelt eine eigene KI-Agenten-Plattform (LangGraph, PostgreSQL, Next.js) für die PR-Branche 

Der Servicemarkt, von Legal über Consulting bis hin zu Agenturen, steht vor der größten Transformation der Geschichte. Gleichzeitig wird der milliardenschwere PR-Markt im Zeitalter von AI-Visibility gerade immer wichtiger. getpress, eine der am schnellsten wachsenden PR-Agenturen Deutschlands (>40 Leute, Kund*innen wie Trivago, Komoot, Fonio AI oder AutoScout24), hat sich entschieden, diesen Wandel zu führen statt abzuwarten. Wir bauen die PR Company der Zukunft: keine reine Service-Company mehr, sondern eine Service-as-a-Software-Company. 

Unser AI-Team besteht nun seit 4 Monaten, aktuell ein Developer, eine Produktmanagerin und unsere Head of AI. Die Grundarchitektur steht, erste Teile unserer PR-Plattform und des Multi-Agent-Systems laufen produktiv. Jetzt fehlst du – die Person, die als Backend Engineer das technische Fundament zusammen mit unserem zweiten Developer ownt und gemeinsam neu definiert, wie die PR der Zukunft funktioniert. 

Deine Rolle - PR-Plattform: Fullstack-Entwicklung der Plattform, die das Operating System der PR-Agentur 2027 wird. Nah an den Nutzer*innen, in schnellen Entwicklungszyklen, und wo deine Entscheidungen den Kurs setzen. 

- KI-Agenten: Aufbau eines Agenten-Systems, das die PR-Wertschöpfungskette End-to-End neu definiert. Du baust die Agenten, mit denen unsere Berater*innen täglich arbeiten, inkl. Self-Learning-Loops und Multi-Agent-Orchestrierung. 

- Systemarchitektur: Mitgestalten der Systemarchitektur, inkl. Workflows, Datenmodell, Schnittstellen, Compliance und Tech Stack (bisher vorwiegend PostgreSQL, Next.js, LangGraph, Docker) 

- Datenmanagement: Weiterentwicklung der Datenbank-Architektur inkl. relationaler Daten- und Vektor-Datenbanken 

Wer du bist Must haves: 

- > 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung 

- > 1 Jahr Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von KI-Agenten und -Komponenten wie Memory, Context-Engineering, Retrieval und Orchestration unter Verwendung von Frameworks wie Langchain, CrewAI, Langgraph o.ä. 

- Tech Stack: TypeScript, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker, Git, LangGraph, Github 

- Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Backend-Systemen mit Frameworks (fastAPI, springboot, nestJS, etc.) und gängigen Programmiersprachen (z.B. Java, Typescript, Python) 

- Erfahrung mit Container-based und Cloud-native Architekturen (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS oder ähnlich) 

- C1-Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil, B2-Niveau ist ausreichend (mit Motivation in deinem ersten Arbeitsjahr den Kurs zu C1 zu machen) 

Nice to haves: 

- Datenkompetenz: Sicher in SQL, API Design, Schema-Design, Query Optimization 

- Erfahrung mit der Integration von KI-/ML-Modellen in Produktionssysteme, sowie im Verständnis des Modellverhaltens, der Modellleistung und der Modellbeschränkungen 

- Product-Engineering: Erfahrung darin, Anforderungen aus Business- und Nutzer:innen-Perspektive einzuordnen, bevor sie technisch umgesetzt werden 

- Erfahrung in Event-Driven Architecture (Kafka, RabbitMQ, o.ä.) 

- Erfahrung mit Agentic Development (Claude Code, Codex, o.ä.) 

Was dich erwartet - Architekt des Tech-Layers: Du bist unser technischer Experte und gestaltest mit, wie getpress Technologie denkt und nutzt 

- KI in Anwendung: Du bringst KI an der Vorfront technischer Möglichkeiten in unsere Prozesse und Strategie 

- Autonomie: Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Management, setzt eigene Ideen um und definierst Standards, an denen wir uns orientieren 

- Ein echtes Team: Wir begegnen einander auf Augenhöhe – offen, ehrlich und mit echtem Interesse am Gegenüber. Wir lernen voneinander, geben einander Rückhalt und feiern gemeinsame Erfolge. 

- Flexibilität, die wirklich gelebt wird: Ob im Berliner Office oder remote (in DE) – wir setzen auf flexible Arbeitsmodelle mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Wir suchen jemanden mit Wohnsitz in Deutschland. Das heißt wann und wo (in DE) du deinen Arbeitsalltag gestaltest, entscheidest du selbst. Klare Kommunikation und Vertrauen sind dabei für uns selbstverständlich. 

Wie gehts weiter? Das klingt genau nach dir? 

Dann sende uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf.

title: Working Student Supply Chain (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission If you're studying supply chain, logistics, or business and want real hands-on experience alongside your studies, this is your chance to see the full supply chain of a scaling food company from the inside. As a Working Student in Supply Chain, you'll support our Retail Operations, Planning, and Procurement teams and help keep daily operations running smoothly. 

Key responsibilities 

- Retail operations: Support the processing of EDI and email orders in SAP, prepare delivery notes and transfer orders, and help coordinate deliveries with logistics partners. 

- Supply chain planning: Help maintain stock, production, and inventory data, and support the Supply Chain Planner with planning overviews. 

- Procurement: Prepare and follow up on purchase orders, check supplier confirmations, and track deliveries of ingredients and packaging. 

- Master data: Keep product, packaging, and supplier data accurate across our systems. 

- Team support: Pick up operational tasks across the team as priorities shift, always in close coordination with the responsible team member. 

- Reporting and process improvement: Prepare regular reports on orders, stock, and purchasing, and help document and improve our supply chain processes.

description:
The Role This is a senior role combining consulting, technology and commercial responsibility . You’ll work directly with customers to understand their processes and challenges, then turn those requirements into practical Smartsheet solutions. You’ll build and present proof of concepts, scope consulting projects, discuss pricing and ultimately help win the work. 
You’ll play an important role in AMX’s continued growth, with an initial focus on the DACH market. You’ll work with opportunities from Smartsheet, our partner network and existing customers, while also helping develop new relationships over time. The focus is on building trust, understanding where AMX can add value and turning strong customer relationships into sustainable growth. 
There’s also real scope for this role to grow. With proven success, you’ll take on broader responsibility for how AMX develops opportunities and goes to market , initially through greater ownership of customers, regions and commercial strategy. Over time, this can also develop into mentoring and guiding the team as it grows. What You’ll Be Doing - Manage customer opportunities end-to-end , from discovery and requirements gathering through solution design, proof of concepts, scoping, pricing and commercial discussions, before handing over to the implementation team. 
- Build strong relationships with existing customers, identifying new use cases and opportunities to expand successful solutions across other teams, departments and markets. 
- Work closely with Smartsheet Account Executives and the wider Smartsheet team on joint account planning, developing opportunities and identifying growth accounts across DACH and AMX’s wider markets. 
- Help develop new opportunities through targeted account research, strategic outreach, events and collaboration with AMX’s marketing and partner network . 
- Contribute to and help shape AMX’s wider consulting and commercial approach , including how we develop opportunities, work with partners and take solutions to market. 
- As you progress, mentor other consultants and take on increasing responsibility across AMX’s commercial activities. 

Your profile - You have strong experience in technology consulting, solutions consulting, SaaS or digital transformation . 
- You’re commercially minded and comfortable taking a customer conversation from discovery through solution design, scoping, negotiation and close. 
- You’re equally technically hands-on and comfortable actually building and demonstrating what you propose. Smartsheet experience is a big advantage, but strong Excel skills or experience configuring SaaS, workflow, low-code or business applications can also be a great fit. 
- You’re good at asking the right questions and turning complex or unclear business problems into structured solutions . 
- You’re confident presenting to senior stakeholders and can explain technical solutions in terms of business value. 
- You enjoy building customer relationships and spotting new opportunities . 
- You’re comfortable working without a perfect playbook. You like bringing your own ideas, testing what works and helping shape the processes and approach that will make AMX successful as we grow . 
- You’re interested in growing beyond an individual contributor role, mentoring others and taking on broader responsibility over time . 
- You speak German at native/C2 level and English fluently. 
- You’re ideally based in Germany and comfortable travelling for customers, partner meetings and events , typically up to five days per month. 
- A relevant degree is welcome, but your experience and what you’ve actually delivered are much more important to us. 

Why us? - You’ll join an established and successful consultancy that is still small enough for you to have a real influence on how things are done. 
- You’ll have genuine flexibility around where you work , with a remote-first setup and only occasional travel for customers, partner meetings and team events. 
- The role comes with a strong fixed salary , with regular salary reviews as your responsibilities and seniority grow. 
- You’ll receive a €3,000 annual learning and development budget , home-office support, a flexible €50 monthly benefits allowance, wellness and technology allowances and regular team retreats. 
- You won’t simply be executing somebody else’s playbook. You’ll have the freedom to bring your own ideas, shape how we work and help define what successful growth looks like . 
- Most importantly, there’s room for this to become much more than a typical Senior Consultant position. If things go well, we want you to take on broader commercial responsibility, help develop the team and play an important role in AMX’s continued growth across DACH and beyond.

- A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.

- 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.

- A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.

- Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.

- Mental health coaching to support your well-being.

- Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.

- The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.

- A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

- Design and develop modern architectures using NEXT.JS, AWS technologies, Microservices, NoSQL, and event-driven architectures .

- Take ownership of solution architecture, improving performance, security, scalability, modularity, and operational efficiency.

- Drive feature development from inception to delivery, contributing to an ambitious product roadmap.

- Conduct knowledge-sharing sessions and hands-on exposure to emerging technologies.

- Foster an open communication culture, encouraging feedback and supporting conflict resolution.

Your Profile: 

- 6+ years of experience in software development.

- Proficiency in Next.js / Node.js , with experience building reusable libraries using an atomic design system.

- Strong foundation in object-oriented programming and concurrent event-based systems.

- Advanced knowledge of TypeScript , including its environment and type system.

- Extensive expertise in GraphQL .

- Keen architectural mindset with an eye for application design patterns .

- Excellent communication skills with fluency in English (written and spoken).

Desirable Skills: 

- Working knowledge of Apollo GraphQL .

- Experience with PHP Symfony .

- Experience working with AWS cloud .

- Basic understanding of SQL databases and schema-less concepts.

- Knowledge of E2E testing (e.g., WebdriverIO, Selenium, or similar tools).

- TA Call : Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.

- Technical Round : Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case) , and meet your potential manager.

title: People Operations Working Student
description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world. 

GET TO KNOW US 

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing! 

THE OPPORTUNITY 

We are hiring a People Operations Working Student to our People Operations team in Berlin !

This role is to join our People Operations team, dedicated to delivering an exceptional employee experience across Europe. In this role, you will contribute to meaningful People initiatives and gain valuable exposure to key HR topics including employment law, payroll, and HR systems (e.g., Personio), all within a fast-paced, international environment

YOUR IMPACT 

- Address and resolve employee queries with clarity and care by guiding them to the right resources.

- Support payroll processing by accurately entering and validating HR data in a timely manner.

- Assist with internal audits, documentation, and the gathering of key compliance information.

- Maintain accurate HR data in Personio and support reporting to inform data-driven decision-making.

- Contribute to process optimization and strategic People projects spanning the entire employee lifecycle, including onboarding and offboarding.

- Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE 

- A university student currently enrolled in HR, Business, or a related discipline, available to work between 15 and 20 hours per week.

- A fluent communicator with C1+ level proficiency in both written and spoken German and English.

- A Berlin-based candidate who can work on-site from our Head Office 2–3 times per week.

- A discreet professional with a proven ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with high integrity.

- A self-driven, adaptable, and collaborative team player with excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail.

- A proactive learner passionate about employee experience, eager to develop skills in project management, stakeholder management, and HR operations across Europe.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that current university enrollment and fluency in German and English (C1+) are mandatory requirements. 

WHAT WE OFFER YOU 

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. 

PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled. 

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. 

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. 

Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube ! 

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub 

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here. 

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Job Applicant Privacy Notice.

title: Senior CRM Manager - Transformation (all genders)
description:
The role 

We are looking for a Senior CRM Manager - Transformation to make CRM Self-Service at HelloFresh a reality.

Our central Growth function has a clear vision: Enabling our local marketing and product teams to reach our customers directly, via push notifications, in-app messaging and emails. For this to work in an efficient and customer-centric way, the right guardrails, tools and knowledge need to be in place.

Your first mission is to design, launch and scale our CRM self-service model. You’ll do this hand in hand with our CreativeTech squad (Product and Engineering), who are building the future CRM environment in an AI-native way. You’ll work closely with the squad, and potentially be embedded in it. You’ll be the voice of CRM and of our internal users, helping define what this environment needs to look like so teams can send communications safely and independently.

This is 0-to-1 work in a highly ambiguous space where no one has been before: no playbook, no rules. AI and LLMs change fast and often, so you’ll think about what we need in the future, even if today’s models aren’t ready yet, and be prepared for when they catch up. The learning curve will be steep, but you’ll climb it on the go, together with the team. Our goal: protect our environment from the agents, and protect the agents from our environment. 

From there, your focus will follow where CRM needs it most. You’ll take on further transformation projects, so this role is for someone who enjoys building something new and then moving on to the next challenge.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do 

- Lead the self-service rollout: Take end-to-end ownership of the programme, from framing the scope and aligning stakeholders to launching and tracking adoption

- Shape the future CRM platform: Collaborate with Product and Engineering to define how our agentic CRM environment should work, bringing in the needs of users and helping prioritise what gets built next 

- Steer CRM Agents: Build the skills and context agents need to create campaigns reliably, on brand and within our guardrails 

- Build frameworks and playbooks: Develop the documentation, training and processes that let teams send safely without central support

- Enable the teams: Design and run user centric training and onboarding for local marketing and product teams, and turn user feedback into improvements

- Make performance visible: Define and create reportings to measure success

- Scale what works: Identify new use cases to move to self-service and manage each transition end to end

- Drive the next CRM initiatives: Once self-service is established, take ownership of further cross-functional projects that make our CRM team more scalable and efficient

- Modernize processes with AI: Collaborate with the CreativeTech squad and CRM Operations to adapt AI use cases within our CRM workflows 

- Influence the CRM product roadmap: Collaborate with Product and Engineering to shape the future CRM platform, bringing in the needs of users and helping prioritise what gets built next

What you’ll bring 

- Strong project or programme management skills, with experience driving complex initiatives across many cross-functional stakeholders, including Tech, Product and local teams

- Experience working in or closely with product and engineering teams, ideally in agile or sprint-based ways of working

- Experience applying AI to real workflows, such as automating processes, creating content or analysing data, and the ability to help non-technical colleagues do the same 

- Solid CRM operations experience (4+ years): you have built and sent campaigns on at least one major CRM platform (ideally Iterable) and know how things can go wrong

- Experience training non-specialist users and explaining technical topics in plain language

- A natural instinct for documentation, process design and knowledge sharing

- A detail-oriented approach to governance: you spot risks before they become incidents

- Comfort with ambiguity and changing priorities: you can switch between projects and build structure where none exists yet

What we offer 

Compensation & Financial Wellbeing

- You’ll receive a competitive salary package, including a HelloFresh-subsidized pension scheme.

- Enjoy savings on your weekly HelloFresh box.

- Save with discount schemes with corporate benefits and Vorteile.

- Get to work with ease through sustainable travel perks and transportation benefits.

Culture & Environment

- Enjoy tasty in-office meal deals and fresh food options.

- We support working families with parent-friendly policies, an in-office kids corner, and an on-site babysitter.

After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within 5 business days.

title: Principal Security Engineer, Security Tribe
description:
The role 

We are looking for a Principal Security Engineer to serve as one of HelloFresh's most senior technical authorities in Security — shaping how we protect the company today while defining the security foundations we will need for the future.

This is not a Principal role defined by ownership of a single security domain. Your domain is HelloFresh. 

You will operate at the intersection of technology strategy, security architecture, engineering and business risk , influencing some of the most consequential technical decisions we make. You will partner with senior Engineering, Product, Data, IT and business leadership to ensure security is not something applied after strategic decisions are made, but a fundamental input into those decisions. 

You think in systems, not Initiatives — and in years, not quarters. 

Where others see an IAM issue, application vulnerability, endpoint incident or AI risk, you look for the architectural condition connecting them. You ask not only “How do we fix this?” but “Why can this class of failure exist at HelloFresh, and what should we change so that it becomes difficult by design?” 

Your job is not merely to secure the systems HelloFresh has today. It is to influence what HelloFresh builds next, define the security architecture that makes it possible, and raise the technical capability of the organisation so that secure-by-default becomes a property of the company itself. 

You will bring exceptional breadth across Cloud Security, Application & Product Security, Vulnerability Management, Offensive Security, Detection & Response, Enterprise IT Security, IAM & Zero Trust, Endpoint/MDM, Governance & Risk, Third-Party & Supply-Chain Security, and GenAI Security — with the depth and judgment to challenge our strongest specialists and go hands-on when the hardest problems demand it.

What you'll do 

- Demonstrate strong bias for action , moving quickly from ambiguity and constraints to clear decisions, ownership, and measurable outcomes. Balance speed with sound judgment, ensuring critical security risks are addressed decisively without creating unnecessary process or delay . 

- Make Security AI-native. Identify operational work across Security that should no longer require repetitive human execution. Drive agents, automation, internal security products and self-service capabilities that encode security expertise and make it available at company scale — with appropriate permissions, human oversight, evaluation and auditability.

- Shape company and Group strategy through Security. Act as a strategic technical advisor to senior and executive leadership, influencing multi-year technology and business strategy across platforms, products, cloud, enterprise technology, AI, acquisitions and emerging technologies. Translate complex security issues into choices involving customer trust, resilience, engineering velocity, investment and business risk.

- Own and elevate secure design and architecture at scale across HelloFresh. Define our security architectural principles, reference architectures, trust boundaries, standards, patterns and guardrails with the security leads. Act as a senior technical advisor for our most consequential architecture and security-risk decisions.

- Connect the entire security system. Establish coherent technical direction across Cloud Security, AppSec/Product Security, Vulnerability Management, Offensive Security, Detection & Response, IT Security, IAM/Zero Trust, Endpoint & MDM, GRC and Third-Party/Supply-Chain Security. Identify systemic risks that individual teams cannot see or solve in isolation. Bring the industry perspective to implementation.

- Eliminate classes of risk, not individual findings. Drive secure-by-default cloud and product architecture across AWS, Kubernetes, IAM, networking, APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD and software supply chains. Evolve vulnerability management, offensive security and detection toward threat-informed, exploitability-driven and continuously validated defence.

- Define security for the AI and agentic era. Establish architecture for GenAI applications, LLMs, RAG, AI agents, MCP ecosystems and AI-assisted engineering — covering identity, permissions, tool access, data boundaries, prompt injection, model supply chain, monitoring and auditability. Provide direction for AWS Bedrock, Claude, Gemini, open-source GenAI models and open-source security-focused GenAI models and tooling .

- Be a force multiplier. Mentor Staff, Senior Staff and Principal-track engineers, challenge architectural assumptions and raise the technical ceiling across Security and HelloFresh. Remain hands-on enough to prototype, review code, analyse attack paths and validate difficult technical decisions when required.

What you'll bring 

- 15+ years of deep technical experience , with demonstrated impact at Senior Staff, Principal, Security Architect or comparable scope. The scale of your impact matters more than the number itself.

- Exceptional breadth across security with recognised depth in multiple domains and a track record of shaping company-wide technical strategy and architecture .

- Deep expertise across several of Cloud Security, Product/AppSec, Offensive Security, Detection & Response, IAM/Zero Trust, Enterprise/IT Security, Endpoint/MDM, Security Platform Engineering and AI Security — with strong fluency across the broader landscape.

- Deep understanding of AWS/cloud-native architecture, Kubernetes, IAM, networking, modern application architecture, APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD and software supply chains.

- Strong adversarial judgment and the ability to connect architecture, realistic attack paths, exploitability, detection and business consequence.

description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. title: Senior Product Manager (Licensing & Billing)
description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. 

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

- Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

- Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

- Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register .

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Your main goal will be to make it simple and reliable for customers to buy, pay for, and grow their use of n8n. You'll own the foundations of how n8n's commercial system works: licensing and entitlements, customer accounts, and the metering and billing platform for both Cloud and Enterprise. Today these live across several teams and two billing stacks; you'll bring them into one stable home that the rest of the company builds on.

This is a foundations role. You build the system that pricing and packaging decisions run on, rather than running price experiments yourself. To do so, here are your core responsibilities:

OWN THE LICENSING & BILLING STRATEGY & ROADMAP

- Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap for Licensing & Billing in partnership with Engineering, Product leadership, Finance, and go-to-market.

- Prioritize foundational investments based on revenue integrity, enterprise needs, data correctness, and engineering effort, and make trade-offs explicit.

- Lead discovery with enterprise customers, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and RevOps to understand how n8n is bought, renewed, and grown today, and where that breaks.

LICENSING, ENTITLEMENTS & ACCOUNTS

- Own the license server and entitlement model: issuance, renewal, and validation across Cloud, self-hosted, air-gapped, and OEM deployments, with one source of truth for which plan or deal grants which features.

- Introduce "account" as a first-class product primitive (accounts, purchases, license keys, activations) and expose it as the API contract our customer-facing console and multi-instance management are built on.

- Productize the deal-to-entitlement flow so a closed deal in Salesforce creates or updates entitlements without manual steps.

METERING & BILLING PLATFORM

- Own usage metering and billing for Cloud and Enterprise, including subscription billing: what counts as a billable execution, quota consumption, and overage charging.

- Lead the migration off Paddle Classic and unify Cloud and Enterprise billing into one platform.

- Build the mechanics for usage-based enterprise billing and reliable overage charging.

CROSS-ORG ALIGNMENT

- Make the architecture and mechanism decisions (entitlement model, billing platform, enterprise invoicing path) and align closely with Finance and go-to-market on each of them. Every decision here touches money; you bring people along rather than inform them afterwards.

- Hold clear boundaries with adjacent teams: the customer console, execution limits, and access control live elsewhere; you own the data and mechanics they rely on.

- Establish clear success measures and keep the squad accountable for outcomes, not only delivery.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

- Billing or licensing product experience: You have 6+ years in Product, with a substantial part spent owning a billing, licensing, entitlement, or quote-to-cash system at a B2B SaaS company.

- Shipped through Finance and RevOps: You've driven a cross-functional systems change where Finance, Sales Ops, and Engineering all had a say, and you got it live.

- Systems and data-model depth: You can design or critique an entity model, reason about reconciliation and idempotency in a sync, read an API contract, and explain why two systems reading the same events end up with different numbers.

- Attention to detail: You know that if the billing data is wrong, everything built on it inherits the error, and you sequence work accordingly.

- Prioritization under ambiguity: You make trade-offs explicit and connect foundational or data-quality work to commercial outcomes.

- Ownership and autonomy: You grab problems without being asked, fix what you see broken, and drive outcomes without waiting for direction.

- Exceptional communication: You're equally at home with engineers, the Finance team, and Sales, and you can make billing trade-offs legible to all of them.

- Enterprise reality: You understand what self-hosted, air-gapped, and OEM deployments mean for licensing and metering.

Nice-to-haves

- Usage-based billing: You've owned usage-based or hybrid (subscription plus usage) billing.

- Vendor billing stacks: You've worked hands-on with Paddle, Stripe, Chargebee, Zuora or similar, and know where they break at enterprise contract volume.

- Migration experience: You've run a billing-provider migration.

- Hands-on ability: You can read code, query data, or prototype, even if you're not shipping it.

- CRM integration: You've worked on Salesforce or CRM-to-billing integrations.

- Domain familiarity: You know workflow automation, agent orchestration, or open-source / developer-community products.

- Writing culture: You default to writing things down to create clarity and alignment.

Why join us? 

At n8n, you'll be in the middle of the AI revolution. The shift from deterministic automation to agent autonomy is a genuinely open design space, and n8n has a credible claim to owning it. Every plan we sell, every enterprise contract, and every agent run that gets metered and billed runs on the foundation you own: licensing, entitlements, accounts, and the billing platform across Cloud and Enterprise. Your work directly shapes how n8n makes money and how easily customers can buy, grow, and trust what they pay for, from self-serve Cloud to air-gapped and OEM deployments.

You'll join one of Europe's fastest growing startups at the sweet spot: small enough to have real impact and be empowered, big enough that your work already reaches massive scale and serious enterprise customers. You'll work with experienced engineers, Finance, and go-to-market on problems where the details are the product, in an AI-native, empowered culture of humble, kind, yet driven and direct people, where you're hired to think, not just to execute. And with our fair-code model, a passionate open-source community gives you a direct feedback loop on everything you ship.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now, and help us build the commercial foundation of the future of reliable AI automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. 

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work. 

Our company language is English. 

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n ( https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35 ).

Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future. 

Benefits 

- Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

- Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

- Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

- Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

- US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

- Health & wellness 🩺 –

- Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

- US : Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

- Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

title: Senior Content and Social Media Manager
description:
🚀 About Nivoda 

Nivoda is a fast-growing B2B marketplace that is transforming the global diamond and gemstone industry. We connect buyers and sellers across the world, processing $300M+ in annual transactions and unlocking a $350B industry opportunity. We move fast, think big, and care deeply about the businesses and people we serve.

🌍 Our Mission 

The diamond trading industry has historically been fragmented, opaque, and inaccessible. Nivoda was founded to change that: to empower businesses of all sizes and locations to participate in a fair, efficient global marketplace. Every line of code, every integration, every automation we build brings us closer to that mission.

🤔 About the Role 

We are looking for a Sr. Content and Social Media Manager to own our social channels and be the creative engine behind our marketing campaigns. You are a storyteller first and an operator second: you can take an idea, shape it into something people actually want to watch and share, and make it show up consistently everywhere we publish.

This is a connective role. You will own the content calendar, plan and run campaigns end to end, keep a strong and consistent presence on social, and run our newsletter. You will be the glue across marketing, making sure a campaign lands as one coherent story across social, email, and beyond rather than a set of disconnected posts. As the team grows we will add editorial depth alongside you (long-form writing and podcast production), so you can stay focused on what you do best: social, storytelling, and campaigns that move.

What would you be doing? 

- Own Nivoda’s social media channels end to end, from strategy and calendar to publishing and community, with Instagram and our primary channels front and centre.

- Be the main creative force behind our marketing campaigns: come up with the idea, shape the story, and make it show up consistently across every channel.

- Own the content calendar and keep every channel in sync, so campaigns land as one coherent story rather than scattered posts.

- Plan and run campaigns end to end: the brief, the timeline, the assets, the launch, and the follow-through.

- Run "The Modern Jewellers Playbook", our newsletter. Own the cadence and the sends, and tie it into everything else we are publishing.

- Turn our bigger content moments, like interviews, launches, and guides, into a steady stream of social-first content that travels.

- Write social and short-form copy that sounds like a real person and makes independent jewellers stop scrolling.

- Work with our designer and video partners to ship content that looks as good as it reads, and with our paid marketer to amplify what is working.

- Be the connective tissue across marketing: link events, campaigns, and content so nothing happens in a silo.

- Track what performs across channels and use it to sharpen the calendar. Double down on what lands, and drop what does not.

What do we need from you? 

- 4+ years running social and content for a brand, with real ownership of channels and campaigns rather than just scheduling posts.

- You are a storyteller first. You know how to take an idea and make it land as a post, an email, a thread, or a reel.

- A body of social and campaign work you are proud of, ideally including channels you grew yourself.

- You can write. Quickly, well, and in a voice that sounds human rather than corporate.

- Sharp project management. You can run a content calendar and several campaigns at once without dropping any threads.

- Comfort working hands-on on a small team and building process where none exists.

- Fluent with the tools of modern social and content work, and happy to lean on AI to move faster.

- An instinct for what performs, and the discipline to let data settle the debates.

Nice to have 

- Knowledge of the jewelry industry

- Experience marketing to small business owners, retailers, or a trade and craft audience.

- Hands-on with short-form video: you can shoot and cut a reel yourself, or confidently direct someone who can.

- Experience running an email or newsletter program.

- Community-building experience, online or off.

We're a high-growth company in an exponential expansion phase. We move fast, operate with low hierarchy, and give people real ownership from day one. If you want to work somewhere you can genuinely shape things: not just maintain them: Nivoda is the place.

title: Software Engineer, Foundation
description:
Job Description 

In short : We're looking for a Software Engineer to join our foundation team with a focus on mobile. You don't need to have years of experience in platform engineering But, you do need to have shipped real production software, to care about how things are built, and to already be working with agentic coding tools every day.

We're building the #1 AI learning companion for 1 billion students. A future where every student on the planet can access, enjoy & benefit from the highest quality education. Since founding Knowunity straight out of high school in 2020, we've been committed to revolutionising how students learn.

Millions of students already use our AI learning companion weekly. We just raised €27m - Europe’s largest education round in the past three years. The AI learning market is at an inflection point, finally enabling true personalisation at scale, and we're determined to build the first AI learning unicorn in this space.

You will join an elite team of +60 hands-on builders serving 1 billion students worldwide. If we execute on our product vision, you will have built something generational that transforms education globally. This is your chance to build a generational company that shapes how an entire generation learns.

What makes this different 

You build at the frontier of AI engineering. We’re building the foundation for agents to build fast and with high quality on our code base. This includes custom MCP servers, our background agent platform, and end-to-end agentic loops. This is an open engineering problem, not a solved one, and you'll be shaping our answer to it.

Your work multiplies across 25+ engineers. A design system component you build gets used in a hundred screens. A CI pipeline you cut from 15 minutes to 2 gives the whole org back a day a week. Foundation is the highest-leverage place in our engineering org, and the leverage is measurable.

Millions of students use what you ship. Foundation isn't a team that only builds for other engineers. You'll also build features that land in front of millions of users.

Real ownership, early. We're a small team with a large surface. You'll own meaningful pieces of the app and the toolchain from your first months.

Craft is taken seriously. We care how the app feels: how a sheet animates, how a list scrolls under load, how a component behaves at the edges. If you've ever been quietly annoyed by four pixels, you'll fit in here.

Find out more here!: This AI studying app with 25M+ downloads is built with Flutter 

What you'll work on 

Mobile foundation. The core of our Flutter app: shared components, the design system, state management, performance, and the tooling around it. You'll extend it, keep it healthy, and make it obvious for product teams to use correctly.

Agentic and AI infrastructure. MCP servers, our background agent platform, evals and feedback loops, and the integration of agentic tooling into our day-to-day workflow. A research background isn't required; a serious interest in agents as an engineering discipline is.

Developer experience. CI/CD, release tooling, and the feedback loop between writing code and seeing it live. Much of this work starts by noticing the same friction three times and deciding to remove it.

Product features. Shipping user-facing work alongside platform work, both to move the product and to stay honest about what it's actually like to build on our foundation.

Reliability and maintenance. Keeping what exists dependable, so 25+ engineers can build on it without thinking about it.

You will grow at Knowunity by 

- Learning architecture by doing it. You'll make real design decisions on the app's core, with review and mentorship from engineers who have architected mobile apps at scale. You'll see those decisions tested by 25 engineers and millions of users within weeks.

- Becoming genuinely strong at agentic engineering. Almost nobody is an expert here yet. You'll be building the practice for a whole engineering org while the field is still being written.

- Widening past mobile. Foundation's scope covers Go services, infrastructure, and delivery. You'll be expected to have opinions beyond the app, and you'll have the room to develop them.

- Working close to the whole org. Platform work means talking to every team. You'll get an unusually complete picture of how a product organisation actually functions, faster than you would inside a single product team.

- Operating at real scale. Millions of users, 26 countries, and a codebase where "it works on my machine" isn't the finish line.

What we're looking for 

Must haves 

- A few years of production experience building mobile (we use Flutter and Dart) or web applications.

- Daily use of agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar) and opinions on where they work well, where they don't, and how to work around it.

- An eye for design. You notice when spacing is inconsistent, when an animation feels wrong, when a component is close but not right.

- Clear communication in English and a genuine preference for improving systems that slow other people down, whether or not your name ends up on a shipped feature.

Nice to haves
