title: Platform Security Engineer
description:
At Scality, we build software that stores and protects the world’s most critical data — running on Linux, inside some of the largest infrastructures on the planet, at exabyte scale, for organizations that cannot afford to fail.

We are looking for a Platform Security Engineer to join our platform and delivery team in Paris. This is a new seat, and it exists because security work needs dedicated capacity. Absorbed as background tasks between feature tickets, it never gets the focus it deserves. You would be that dedicated capacity.

This is a Linux-first, hands-on engineering role. You will not write policies for other people to implement — you will write the Python and Bash that hardens our OS, automates our vulnerability management, and proves to auditors and customers that our supply chain is sound.

About Scality 
Scality is the leader in software-defined object storage, trusted by 1,000+ enterprises and 700M+ users worldwide across banking, healthcare, and government sectors — exactly the sectors where security posture is a purchasing criterion, not a checkbox.

Industry recognition: 

- Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader for 9 consecutive years — the only 100% software-defined storage company to hold this position since the quadrant’s inception

- #1 on the GigaOm Radar for Enterprise Object Storage (2024), ahead of 17 competing vendors

- Gold Stevie Award 2025 — ARTESCA 3.0, Cloud Storage & Backup Solution category

- Net Promoter Score of 85 across RING and ARTESCA

About the team 

You will join a small team of highly skilled Linux engineers responsible for delivering and maintaining ADI (Scality Autonomous Data Infrastructure), our full platform: RING (object storage), S3C (S3-compatible layer), and SCOS (Scality OS — our own Linux distribution).

The team works across the full stack of infrastructure engineering — deep Linux system integration, RPM packaging, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and release automation. The command line is where most of our day happens, and we ship a Linux distribution to customers.

How We Build 

We build with AI tools, in earnest rather than as an experiment. Every engineer here has Claude Code, and it is part of how we write, review, and ship code day to day.

We are also designing something larger: an AI code and delivery factory — AI woven into the build and release chain itself, not just into the editor. That work is early and still being thought through rather than already solved. We expect it to become part of how we maintain the platform, and CVE remediation is one of the first places we think it fits: an automated path from advisory to assessment to a patched, tested, delivered build.

If that sounds like a problem you would want to work on, this role sits close to it.

One principle is not negotiable: a human owns the outcome. AI writes code here, and when it does, we own what it produces — the review, the decision to ship, the consequences, and the fix. “The tool did it” is not an explanation we accept from ourselves, and it is not one we would offer a customer. In security work that matters doubly: an answer you cannot defend is worse than no answer at all.

How This Role Works 

Scality is building a network of security engineers across the engineering department — a security peer embedded in each development team, rather than a central security function working at arm’s length from the code. You would be that peer for the platform and delivery team.

- Security priorities are owned by our VP of Engineering. The agenda is set at that level, with dedicated resources committed across the teams. You will not have to invent it alone — and you will have a voice in it: the engineers closest to the code help decide what goes on the roadmap. We will be straight with you: today security work competes with delivery commitments and too often loses. Naming an owner and funding dedicated people is how we intend to change that. You would help build that capability, not inherit a finished one.

- The team is accountable for the deliveries. Security items sit on the team’s plate alongside everything else it commits to, rather than in a separate function filing tickets from the outside.

- You are the dedicated resource that makes them happen. While your teammates carry releases, OS compatibility, and platform features, your time is reserved for the security work. That focus is the whole reason the seat exists.

- You share the team’s perimeter and its knowledge. Same repositories, same Jira projects, same code reviews, same sprint rituals. The engineers around you have rare, hard-earned Linux depth — OS integration, RPM packaging, boot and GRUB, CI/CD, monitoring — and you will learn the platform from them.

- You will have peers. Security engineers embedded in the other development teams work the same problems on different perimeters. That network is where you compare notes, share tooling, and grow into the craft.

The point of the model is that security decisions get made inside the team that builds and ships the product, by someone who understands the build system rather than filing tickets against it.

Your First Missions 

Two priorities are already on the roadmap, and they will shape your first year.

1. CVE exposure, answered before it is asked

Customers in banking, healthcare, and government ask us, routinely and under their own audit obligations, whether our products are exposed to a given CVE. That will not stop — for them, asking is the compliance requirement. Today each answer is researched from scratch: a customer question becomes a ticket, the ticket becomes a hunt through SBOMs, vendor advisories, and our own configuration, and the round trip can take weeks to produce something the team is not fully confident defending.

Your first mission is to invert that, so the answer already exists when the question arrives.

- A standing exposure record , per shipped component and per release: what the SBOM says is present, what the upstream vendor has decided (including “will not fix”, which is common on RHEL 8 and often the real answer), and whether the vulnerable code path is actually reachable in our configuration

- Reachability over presence. A module shipped and loaded by a distribution default is not the same as a module configured on a live URL. That distinction is the difference between “vulnerable” and “no impact”, and it is where the engineering judgement lives

- Continuous CVE detection across our repositories, vendored third-party modules, container images, and shipped RPMs

- Wiring detection into our existing SBOM tooling and GitHub Actions pipelines, so exposure is computed when a release is built rather than when a customer asks

- A defined interface with the security engineers and the customer-facing teams: who produces the technical assessment, who owns the wording that reaches the customer, and how both meet the response commitments in our customer security policy

- Durable capture. An assessment that lives only in a ticket comment gets re-derived next release. Findings belong somewhere queryable

- A remediation loop with clear ownership and response targets, integrated with how the team already works in Jira

- AI-assisted remediation , where it fits: from advisory to proposed patch to a tested build, with a human deciding what ships

Done well, a customer’s “are you affected by X?” becomes a lookup and an afternoon, not an escalation and three weeks.

2. Raising the security baseline of SCOS

SCOS is our own Linux distribution — we control the kickstarts, the package set, the boot path, and the images. That is unusual leverage, and we intend to use it. You will drive platform-level hardening across the OS we ship:

- A hardened, defensible default configuration for the distribution

- Advancing SELinux enforcement across RING and S3C (work already begun on the team, which you will help carry)

- Supply-chain integrity: artifact provenance, signing, dependency currency, reproducible and verifiable builds

- Secrets and credential handling across the delivery pipeline

- Cryptographic posture — including FIPS 140-3 readiness, which matters concretely: FIPS 140-2 certificates move to NIST’s historical list on 22 September 2026, and RHEL 9’s validated OpenSSL, GnuTLS, and kernel crypto modules are the foundation we build on

- Compliance-driven engineering work, notably the supply-chain security expectations of NIS2 (Article 21(2)(d)) and the EU Cyber Resilience Act — translated into automation and evidence, not spreadsheets

You will also contribute to what comes next: threat modelling of the platform, hardening guidance for customers, and security review of significant design changes.

What We Are Looking For 

This is a role for someone early in their career who wants to grow into being their team’s security reference. We expect to invest in you, and we expect you to keep growing here for as long as you want to — there is no ceiling built into this seat.

Required

- Linux is your primary operating system — at work, at home, or both. You are comfortable in the terminal and you reach for a shell before a UI

- Roughly 2–4 years of relevant experience, or a shorter track record with unusually strong evidence of the skills below

- Solid working ability in Python and Bash — you will be writing and maintaining real code in a production codebase

- A genuine, demonstrable interest in security. We care much more about this than about formal credentials. Show it however it is true for you: CTFs, a home lab, reading advisories and CVE writeups for fun, a hardening project, security-adjacent contributions, a blog, anything real

- Comfortable using Git in a collaborative environment

- Ability to read and understand existing code before modifying it

- The judgement to tell a real risk from a scanner’s opinion — and the instinct to check whether vulnerable code is actually reachable before calling it exposed

- The willingness to say plainly when you are not yet sure, rather than producing an answer you could not defend

- French — the team works in French day to day

- Written communication skills in English

Nice to Have

- CVE triage, CVSS scoring, or vulnerability management experience

- Reading vendor advisories and understanding vendor triage — NVD, RHSA, Red Hat severity and will-not-fix calls

- Supply-chain security tooling — SBOM formats (SPDX, CycloneDX), scanners (Trivy, Grype, Syft), artifact signing

- RPM packaging or Linux distribution internals

- SELinux policy work

- CI/CD systems, especially GitHub Actions

- RHEL / Rocky Linux (versions 8 and 9)

- Containers (Docker, containerd, systemd units)

- Ansible or Salt

- Awareness of NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act, or FIPS 140-3

- Familiarity with S3 or object storage concepts

- Serious use of AI coding tools in a real workflow — Claude Code or equivalent, beyond autocomplete

To Be Clear About Scope

This is a software engineering role with a security mandate. It is not a SOC or incident-response analyst position, not a penetration-testing role, and not a GRC or compliance-documentation role. If what you want is to build the tooling and harden the system yourself, in code, you are in the right place.

What We Offer 

- Dedicated focus. Security is your job here, not the thing you get to after the sprint work is done

- Clear direction, and a say in it. Security priorities are owned by our VP of Engineering, and the team is accountable for delivering them. You would not be inventing the agenda on your own, you would help shape what goes on it, and you would be part of making it stick

- A network of peers. Security engineers embedded in the other development teams, working the same problems on different perimeters

- Work that compounds. Customer security questions are a permanent obligation, so every assessment you make reusable and every check you automate keeps paying back, release after release

- Modern tooling, actually adopted. Claude Code in

title: Account Manager Lille
description:
Our Global Structure 

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Pourquoi Deliveroo ? 

Nous transformons la façon dont le monde mange et fait ses courses en rendant leur accès plus pratique et agréable. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les cyclistes. Nous donnons à chaque personne la possibilité d'acheter ce qu'elles veulent, comme elles le veulent, quand elles le veulent et où elles le veulent.

Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, à l'avant-garde d'un secteur qui connaît une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avançons rapidement, valorisons l'autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles idées et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre!

Tes principales missions : 

- Gérer un portefeuille de restaurants clés sur des zones matures, où l'expertise et l'attention au détail font toute la différence.

- Développer des partenariats privilégiés et durables en devenant le point de contact expert de votre zone et en mettant à profit vos connaissances Food Tech.

- Optimiser la performance de vos comptes grâce à un accompagnement personnalisé, construit sur le long terme et nourri par la data.

- Analyser les résultats de vos restaurants, identifier les leviers d'amélioration et recommander des actions concrètes à votre manager tout en restant agile et ouvert à la nouveauté.

- Proposer et mettre en place des campagnes marketing et promotionnelles ciblées pour booster l'attractivité de vos restaurants partenaires.

- Suivre de près le déroulé des opérations afin de garantir la meilleure expérience restaurant et client possible.

Ton expérience et tes qualités : 

- Tu as déjà 2 à 3 ans d'expérience sur un rôle similaire où la gestion d'un portefeuille de partenaires était centrale à ta mission.

- Tu sais négocier et anticiper les discussions commerciales tout en gardant à l'esprit les valeurs de Deliveroo.

- Tu sais garder le contrôle de ton portefeuille , identifier les nouvelles tendances du marché et partager du feedback utile à tes partenaires ainsi qu'à ton manager.

- Le terrain est un lieu où tu te sens à ta place : tu sais construire des relations de confiance avec tes partenaires tout en gardant un œil attentif sur la concurrence.

- Tu sais te montrer proactif , analyser les résultats de tes actions et proposer des recommandations concrètes à ton manager.

- Tu travailles de manière autonome tout en gardant le cap fixé, sais t'approprier des objectifs précis et mets tout en œuvre pour les atteindre.

- Tu sais concevoir des actions spécifiques , adaptées à la fois aux besoins de tes partenaires et à la stratégie définie par ton manager.

- Tu sais identifier, comprendre et analyser les données de performance (commerciales et opérationnelles) pour garantir un niveau de service irréprochable.

- Tu sais t'exprimer en anglais (à l'oral comme à l'écrit)

- Tu arrives à convaincre tout en construisant des relations commerciales solides, durables, où Deliveroo devient le partenaire de choix

- Et si tu cherches un poste où tu travailles en full remote depuis Lille , tout en gardant un lien fort avec le terrain et les équipes, alors c'est peut‑être le rôle qu'il te faut !

La vie chez Deliveroo 

Notre équipe est en forte croissance, notre impact très important, et nous cherchons à répondre aux questions les plus stimulantes du moment. Nous progressons rapidement, nous explorons toujours de nouvelles idées et nous sommes très transparents quant aux décisions que nous prenons et à ce qui motive nos choix.

Il y a tellement de questions que nous souhaitons résoudre, et encore plus que nous n'avons pas encore rencontrées. Comment les données et la technologie peuvent-elles aider les restaurants à développer leur activité à mesure que les habitudes des consommateurs évoluent ? Comment pouvons-nous prédire ce qu'une personne souhaitera pour dîner avant même que l'idée ne lui vienne à l'esprit ? Chez Deliveroo, ces questions ne sont que quelques-uns des défis ambitieux auxquels nous nous efforçons de répondre – et il n'y a aucun projet qui ne peut pas devenir le vôtre. Aucune solution n'appartient à une équipe en particulier, ce qui vous ouvre d'extraordinaires possibilités en termes de développement et d'impact personnel.

Avantages et diversité 

À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l'article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s'engage en faveur de la diversité, l'égalité professionnelle, l'emploi des personnes en situation de handicap.

Deliveroo France valorise la diversité sans discrimination de genre, race, sexualité, religion ou préférences personnelles. Avec un score de 99/100 à l'Indice de l'Égalité Hommes-Femmes 2023, nous sommes engagés envers l'égalité des chances. Rejoignez-nous avec votre passion pour la nourriture dans une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion 

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness .

These scams prey upon an individual’s desire to obtain a job and can sometimes “feel” like a genuine recruitment process. Some red flags are identified below. Should you encounter a recruitment process that claims to be for Owkin but is not consistent with the below, please do not provide any personal or financial information:

- Legitimate Owkin recruitment processes include communication with candidates through recognized professional networks, such as LinkedIn.

- Communication is always through an official Owkin email address (from the @ owkin.com domain), over the phone or through our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

- Legitimate Owkin interviews may be conducted over the phone, in person, or via an approved enterprise videoconferencing service (Google Meets). They will not occur via Signal, Telegram or Messenger 

- Owkin offers of employment are based on merit and only extended once a candidate has interviewed with members of the talent and hiring team. Offers will be extended both verbally and in written format.

If you think that you have been a victim of fraud,

- Check the identity of the talent team on LinkedIn

- Check our senior team on our website https://owkin.com/team/ 

- Check the existence of the position on our website: https://www.owkin.com/careers#current-opportunities

- Passion : Curiosité pour la résolution de problèmes d'architecture/données à grande échelle, la conception centrée utilisateur et une passion affirmée pour le sport !

title: Legal AI Engineer (Zurich)
description:
Description Legartis is on a mission: to unlock legal work at scale.

We set the standard for AI-powered contract work by offering a platform that changes how legal teams work, from drafting through negotiation to completion. We are now looking for the person who turns what customers actually need into what our AI actually does.

Joining Legartis is not taking a job, you take ownership. We are a team of product builders and lawyers, who do not chase hype; we build substance. If you are a lawyer who builds, someone who has stopped waiting for better tools and started making them, this is your moment and your place.

Send us your CV, a short note on why Legartis, and links to anything you have built or published.

Your mission Most companies split this seat across three teams, and that split is exactly the problem. The person who hears the customer describe their workflow should be the person who writes the requirement, and the person who writes the requirement should be able to build the first version themselves. That is you.

1. You translate customer reality into engineering requirements — and into revenue. You sit in customer and expert calls alongside Sales, not as a note-taker but as the person who understands the legal work. In trials and hackathons you coach hands-on: the customer drives, you navigate, and they create the first "wow" moment themselves. When they say "that won't work for us" or "we'll build it ourselves", you answer with a concrete path (a workaround, a workflow, the honest maintenance cost of the alternative) and you leave every conversation with a next step: trial licenses, a hackathon, a scoped rollout. Then you pull out the workflow: what actually happens, in what order, where it breaks, what the customer would pay to never do again. And you write the spec, edge cases, and acceptance criteria that Engineering can build against.

2. You build the skills yourself. You write, test, and ship agent skills and playbooks that solve real customer workflows. You build the evaluation frameworks and test sets that prove they got better rather than just different. When the AI fails on a clause, you diagnose why, at the prompt and context level, and you either fix it or hand Engineering a diagnosis precise enough to act on.

3. You make it repeatable, and therefore sellable. Anything you build once for one customer, you turn into something Sales and Customer Success can run without you. Standard demo environments. A skill library they can reach for. Onboarding that lands in days rather than months. Where Customer Success needs legal depth you step in, fix it, and turn the fix into something the team can handle alone next time. Your success is measured by how rarely you need to be in the room, and by what happens to adoption and expansion when you are not.

4. You are the legal authority in the building. Legal and compliance questions land with you: contract reviews, customer security and data protection questions, the occasional in-house matter which makes roughly ten to fifteen percent of your time. You use our own product to do it, and you tell us honestly when it is not good enough.

Your profile The person we picture. There is a name emerging for what we are describing, and it is not "lawyer who is good with computers". It is legal quant : a lawyer who builds their own tooling to practise law, rather than waiting for a vendor to ship it. The distinction that matters to us: plenty of lawyers now use AI. A legal quant builds with it. They look at a workflow and ask how to redesign it from first principles to get the best possible outcome, rather than making the existing process incrementally faster.

A note on how we are weighting this role. Three capabilities make someone exceptional here: commercial instinct, legal depth, and technical ability to build. The ideal candidate has all three. We know that person is rare, and we are not going to pretend otherwise by writing a wish list and hoping. So for this role we weight the technical evidence most heavily, because it is the hardest of the three to teach on the job.

If you believe you genuinely combine all three, we want to talk to you regardless of how neatly your CV matches the bullets below. Say so in your note and tell us what you have built and what you have sold.

1. Technical track record. You have built things and they exist and ideally you have published some of it. You are fluent with LLMs the way a practitioner is fluent, not a spectator: you know how context windows fail you or why a prompt stopped working. When something breaks you go into the system rather than around it. Scripting, Git, and APIs are a strong plus.

title: Value Strategist
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role 

ElevenLabs is looking for a Value Strategist to help our customers identify, quantify, and realize the business value of ElevenLabs across our portfolio, with a primary focus on ElevenAgents.

This is a senior individual contributor role within our global Revenue organization, spanning the full customer lifecycle from early sales conversations through proof of concept, deployment, renewal, and expansion. You will work directly with customers and prospects to understand their businesses, build the case for investment, and establish how that value will be measured over time.

On our most strategic accounts, Deployment Strategists in our Forward Deployed Engineering team already build account-specific business cases and ROI narratives as part of delivery. You will partner with them rather than duplicate that work. Your mandate is the value discipline across the whole book: the Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Commercial accounts where no one is embedded, and where value today is quantified deal by deal or not at all. You will build the frameworks, benchmarks, calculators, and playbooks that let every seller articulate and measure value consistently, and you will use what you learn from strategic deployments to make that methodology sharper.

This is not a quota-carrying role, nor is it a traditional advisory function. We are looking for a builder and a doer: someone who can engage credibly with senior customer stakeholders, get deep into a customer's operations and data, build rigorous models themselves, and turn ambiguous business problems into clear, actionable recommendations.

You will define how ElevenLabs understands, measures, and communicates customer value globally.

In this role you will 

- Shape value from the beginning. Partner with Revenue teams and prospects early in the sales cycle to understand customer priorities, identify high-value opportunities, and establish the business case for investing in ElevenLabs.

- Build our global value strategy. Develop the frameworks, benchmarks, calculators, discovery approaches, and playbooks that define how ElevenLabs approaches value across industries and use cases.

- Scale what works. Turn bespoke work with our largest customers into repeatable approaches that enable our Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Commercial teams to articulate and measure value without requiring bespoke support for every customer.

- Identify where ElevenLabs can have the greatest impact. Develop a deep understanding of a customer's business, workflows, economics, and strategic priorities to determine which use cases have the greatest potential and why.

- Quantify the opportunity. Build rigorous financial and operational models that translate ElevenLabs use cases into measurable outcomes across revenue, cost, productivity, customer experience, and other relevant dimensions.

- Define how value will be proven. Establish success metrics and measurement approaches for proofs of concept and deployments so that customers and ElevenLabs have a shared understanding of what success looks like from the outset.

- Measure value realization. Partner with customers and internal teams after deployment to understand the impact ElevenLabs is delivering, identify gaps between expected and realized value, and determine where additional opportunities exist.

- Support expansion and long-term customer value. Use insights from existing deployments to help customers understand what they have achieved and identify where ElevenLabs can drive additional impact.

- Work directly with the data. Analyze customer and industry data, build models, pressure-test assumptions, and develop recommendations yourself. You should be equally comfortable working in the details and communicating the implications.

- Partner with Deployment. On strategic accounts, work alongside Deployment Strategists who own the account-level business case, contributing methodology and capturing what works into reusable assets. Across the rest of the book, be the primary owner of value quantification and measurement.

- Influence senior stakeholders. Communicate complex analysis simply and credibly, and engage with senior leaders internally and externally when the opportunity requires it.

Requirements 

- 10+ years of relevant experience across operating roles, strategy, management consulting, analytics, finance, customer strategy, or other roles requiring rigorous business problem solving.

- Strong operating judgment. You understand how businesses work and can quickly get underneath a customer's operating model, workflows, economics, and strategic priorities.

- Exceptional analytical ability. You can personally build sophisticated financial and operational models, work with incomplete or imperfect information, make assumptions explicit, and turn analysis into decisions.

- Structured problem solving. You are comfortable starting with an ambiguous question such as "Where could AI create the most value in this business?" and developing a rigorous approach to answering it.

- Customer credibility. You can work directly with customers across functions and levels, ask incisive questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and establish trust quickly.

- Commercial judgment. You understand how business value connects to technology investment decisions and can partner closely with Revenue teams while maintaining an objective, customer-first perspective.

- Excellent communication. You can distill complex analysis into a clear point of view and communicate it effectively in writing and verbally, from working teams through senior executives.

- A builder mentality. You are excited to start by doing the work yourself, learn from customers, and turn what works into scalable methodologies and tools.

- Comfort with ambiguity and pace. You can move quickly across industries, customer types, and use cases while maintaining a high bar for analytical rigor.

- Ability to operate globally. You are comfortable partnering with teams and customers across regions and traveling when valuable for customer work.

- Willingness to travel. Must be willing and able to travel up to 10% of the time.

Bonus points 

- Experience in strategy or management consulting, particularly in operational transformation, technology, customer experience, or growth.

- Experience as an operator within a technology company or other fast-moving business.

- Experience working on AI, automation, customer experience, or technology-enabled business transformation.

- Experience developing business cases, value frameworks, or analytical methodologies that were ultimately scaled beyond an individual project or customer.

- Experience working with enterprise customers on complex, cross-functional initiatives.

Location 

This is a global role within the Revenue organization. The role can be based in San Francisco or remotely, with the option to work from our San Francisco office.

You will work with customers and ElevenLabs teams across regions and should expect travel for customer meetings and onsite work when it meaningfully advances the work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Senior Director, Market Access Strategy, International
description:
Mavericks Wanted 

When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on 
  
In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible.  
  
Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work. 

About BridgeBio Pharma, Inc. 

BridgeBio is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to discovering, developing, and delivering transformative medicines for patients living with genetic diseases and genetically defined cancers. Since our founding in 2015, we have built a diverse portfolio of more than 20 drug development programs, ranging from early discovery to late-stage clinical trials, across multiple therapeutic areas including precision oncology, cardiology, endocrinology, neurology, and renal disease. We have already achieved regulatory approval for three therapies and continue to advance promising science from academia into meaningful treatments for patients worldwide. 

Who We Are

title: Technical Project Manager (Efector Development)
description:
As Destinus scales its vehicle programmes, we are looking for a dedicated Technical Project Manager to own execution across the full vehicle development stack – from propulsion and structures through avionics integration, ground support equipment, and qualification. title: Stress Engineer - Non-linear & Propellants
description:
The Destinus engineering team is seeking a Stress Engineer to support structural sizing and simulation with a focus on non-linear and thermomechanical analysis of solid rocket motor structures.

What You’ll Do

· Perform thermomechanical analysis across metallic, composite, bonded, and polymeric structures under thermal cycling and operational loads

· Support experimental characterisation of propellant, liner, and bonded joint materials; feed test results (lap shear, peel, tensile, and DMA data) into material models and allowables

· Correlate FE predictions against strain gauge, load, and thermal test data; validate and update models accordingly

· Prepare stress reports, margin-of-safety calculations, and design justification documentation

Requirements

· Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field

· 3–5 years of industry experience in stress analysis of aerospace or mechanical structures

· Proficiency with FEA packages: NASTRAN (Femap or equivalent), Abaqus, or Optistruct/HyperWorks for both linear and non-linear analysis

· Strong classical stress analysis skills: beam theory, buckling, fastener and joint analysis, margin-of-safety calculations

· Experience correlating FE predictions with experimental test data

· Background in solid rocket motor, propulsion, or energetic structures is a strong advantage

title: Technicien(ne) en robotique - Maintenance & SAV
description:
Dans le cadre du développement d'une de nos sociétés nous ouvrons un poste de Technicien(ne).
Principalement dedié à la distribution, le déploiement, la maintenance et le service après-vente de robots professionnels, avec un premier focus sur les robots de nettoyage.

Dans le cadre du développement de notre centre technique en Suisse, nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) en robotique – Maintenance & SAV.

Votre mission

Vous assurez le diagnostic, la réparation, la maintenance, la configuration et la mise en service de robots professionnels de nettoyage.

Vous intervenez sur les différents systèmes qui composent les robots :

- Électronique & électricité : batteries, cartes électroniques, moteurs, capteurs, LiDAR, câblages
- Software : configuration, mises à jour, firmware, navigation, analyse des erreurs et diagnostics
- Circuits d’eau : pompes, tuyaux, vannes, filtres, réservoirs et recherche de fuites
- Aspiration & nettoyage : moteurs d’aspiration, turbines, filtres, brosses et systèmes de lavage
- Mécanique : roues, transmissions, moteurs, démontage, réparation et remplacement de composants
Vous serez également amené(e) à préparer les nouveaux robots, effectuer les maintenances préventives, intervenir chez nos clients en Suisse et collaborer avec les équipes techniques de nos fabricants internationaux.

Requirements 

Nous recherchons une personne technique, polyvalente, curieuse et orientée solutions, qui aime comprendre le fonctionnement d’une machine et rechercher l’origine d’une panne.

Formations recherchées :

- Automaticien(ne) CFC
- Mécatronicien(ne)
- Électronicien(ne) CFC
- Polymécanicien(ne) CFC
- Technicien(ne) ES en systèmes industriels / automation
- ou formation technique équivalente
Une expérience dans la robotique est un avantage, mais n’est pas obligatoire. Une expérience en maintenance de machines, équipements industriels ou électromécaniques est également très intéressante.

Compétences:

- Bonnes connaissances en électronique, électricité et mécanique
- Très bonne aisance informatique
- Capacité à diagnostiquer et résoudre des problèmes techniques
- Autonomie, rigueur et sens pratique
- Intérêt pour la robotique et les nouvelles technologies
- Français courant et bonnes connaissances d’anglais technique
- Allemand : un avantage
- Permis de conduire catégorie B
Benefits 

Vous rejoignez un projet en forte croissance et participez au développement d’un centre d’expertise en robotique professionnelle en Suisse, avec des formations auprès de fabricants internationaux et la possibilité de travailler sur de nouvelles générations de robots.

title: Senior Regional Account Manager Schweiz (m/w/d) Westschweiz Genf, Jura, Freiburg, Bern und Wallis
description:
Über uns Die FormMed HealthCare GmbH entwickelt Mikronährstoff-Präparate für Therapeuten und Ärzte aller Fachrichtungen. Mit über 400 Präparaten bieten wir das größte Mikronährstoff-Konzept Deutschlands. Über 7.000 Ärzte, medizinische Institute und Heilpraktiker arbeiten mit uns zusammen. Das macht FormMed zur Nr. 1 bei Ärzten und Therapeuten in Deutschland. Es macht Spaß, bei uns zu arbeiten! Das Arbeitsumfeld ist trotz komplexer Anforderung menschlich und humorvoll, geprägt von Eigenverantwortung, kurzen Entscheidungswegen, schneller Umsetzung, langjährigen Mitarbeitern:innen und einer Führung durch Vertrauen. Wir verkaufen Gesundheit nicht nur nach außen, sondern leben sie auch nach innen. Du solltest diese Unternehmenskultur zu schätzen wissen und Dich bewusst dafür entscheiden. Wegen unseres stetigen und schnellen Wachstums suchen wir viele neue Kollegen:innen, die uns noch weiter voranbringen und gut ins Team passen. Dabei wirst du Teil eines Teams, das Zusammenarbeit, Vertrauen und kontinuierliche Entwicklung lebt.

Wir suchen ab sofort einen Senior Regional Account Manager Westschweiz (m/w/d) in unbefristeter Anstellung für eine Vollzeittätigkeit im Vertriebsteam mit Fokus auf den Schweizer Markt und insbesondere die Westschweiz.

- Dein Vertriebsgebiet umfasst die Regionen Genf, Jura, Freiburg, Bern und Wallis.

- Du entwickelst eigenständig Strategien zur Marktdurchdringung, Neukundengewinnung und Kundenbindung.
- Du führst persönliche Beratungsgespräche mit Ärzt, Therapeut, Apotheken und weiteren Gesundheitsfachpersonen und bist dabei kompetente Ansprechpartner auf Augenhöhe – fachlich, vertrieblich und menschlich.

- Du verfügst über sehr gute Französischkenntnisse und kannst Kunden sicher und professionell auf Französisch beraten und betreuen.

- Du hast Freude an persönlicher Kundenbetreuung und bist regelmäßig innerhalb deines Vertriebsgebiets unterwegs.
- Du besitzt einen Führerschein der Klasse B und bringst eine hohe regionale Reisebereitschaft innerhalb der Westschweiz mit.

Warum wir? - Home-Office mit High-End-Ausstattung – modern, ergonomisch und perfekt für deinen Vertriebsalltag
- Dienstwagen der gehobenen Mittelklasse – auch zur privaten Nutzung

title: Product Manager (Atomic Team)

Our team is driven by ownership, experimentation and a shared commitment to delivering meaningful impact at scale.

About the role 

Over 60 million people use Smallpdf every month to do one thing: compress a file, convert it, translate it, merge it. Our core tools are freemium and SEO-led: people find us through Google and, more and more, through AI assistants. They finish the job and leave.

As Product Manager for our core tools, you make that single task the fastest, easiest and best on the market, so search engines, AI assistants and people send users back. You own the individual tools end to end. Together with our growth team, you work on the channels that bring people to them: organic search, paid search and AI search. You work in Zurich with a fully staffed product team, including an EM, a designer and engineering counterparts, and closely with our SEO, growth and marketing teams.

Responsibilities 

- Own the individual tools end to end: upload experience, processing, output quality, download

- Ship AI features where they help users, with a clear process for accuracy, cost and quality before launch

- Design, monitor and analyse experiments on millions of sessions, and ship, iterate or kill on the result

- Run deep analyses and user research yourself, and be the voice of the user in every decision

- Set the strategy and roadmap for your area from user feedback, data and business goals, with a commercial case, cost and outcome metrics for every bet

- Align engineering, design, SEO, growth, marketing and other product teams on what ships and why

- Lead without authority: manage up with clear recommendations, settle ownership with peer teams, and present plans and results to leadership and the whole company

- Raise the bar around you: help your team own product decisions, give and take honest feedback, coach others, and step outside the PM role when it moves the needle

About you

- Hands-on A/B testing experience on a product with real traffic

- AI in your daily work: workflows, analysis, prototyping, research. You know where it goes wrong and you check it

title: Technical Customer Support Specialist
description:
About HappyRobot 

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. 

About the Role 
As a Customer Support Engineer , youʼll be on the front lines of our customer
experience. Youʼll work directly with customers to quickly triage issues, debug
problems, and ensure theyʼre getting the most out of HappyRobotʼs AI platform.

This role is a hybrid between technical support and customer engineering: youʼll
diagnose issues, design and test quick solutions, and collaborate closely with both
engineering and product teams to make our platform even stronger.

Youʼll also apply prompt engineering skills to help customers fine-tune their AI
workers, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and speed across real-world logistics
workflows.

This role is ideal for someone with strong technical fundamentals who wants to
grow into a more senior customer engineering or product-facing position over
time.

Tech Profile 

- Comfortable Full-Stack: Python, React, TypeScript, Node.js. 

- Experience managing APIs and integrations with third-party systems.

- Some exposure to infrastructure and cloud deployments.

- Familiarity with LLM prompting and tuning of voices/transcribers; eager to
experiment and iterate.

- Strong debugging and problem-solving skills — quick at identifying the root
cause of issues.

Must Have 

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English — able to explain
technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

- Strong ability to triage, prioritize, and resolve issues independently under
tight deadlines.

- Curiosity and adaptability: you can learn customer workflows quickly and
propose solutions.

- Self-starter mindset — comfortable working independently, with a bias toward
action.

- Passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences.

Why join us? 

- Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

- Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

- Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

- Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

- Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

Our Operating Principles 

Extreme Ownership 

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship 

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
In healthcare, the phone is still the front door, and call volume keeps rising while the people answering it are harder to hire and keep. You'll own our North America enterprise motion across providers, payers, and life sciences, helping health organizations put agents in front of patients, members, and clinicians that are safe, fast, and fit the systems they already run. You'll have the mandate to build the playbook and the team.

In this role, you will: 

- Own the enterprise healthcare function across health systems, payers, and pharma/medtech: strategy, pipeline, forecast, process, execution

- Define the enterprise ICP, sales methodology, and a repeatable motion for each segment

- Build and lead a high-performing enterprise sales team

- Land and expand with large health systems, health plans, and life sciences companies

- Work through BAAs, security review, and AI governance boards (and MLR review for pharma), starting compliance conversations in week one

- Partner with our Forward Deployed Engineers to scope integrations with the EHR, claims, and telephony systems customers already run

- Help customers pick one high-volume starting point (scheduling, reminders, after-hours coverage, benefits and claims status, HCP support) and prove it before scaling

- Build a reference network of healthcare peers that buyers can call

- Lead executive briefings, events, and high-stakes negotiations

- Bring a sharp view of the competitive landscape, including build-vs-buy, platform bundlers, and vertical point solutions, to positioning and strategy

- Set the bar for sales culture, integrity, and customer-first execution

Requirements: 

- Proven enterprise sales leadership in a high-growth, product-led tech company (AI/ML strongly preferred)

- Track record selling to health systems, payers, or life sciences, with fluency in HIPAA, BAAs, and long, multi-stakeholder cycles

- Experience building and scaling sales teams from the ground up

- Seven-figure enterprise deals and complex sales cycles

- Ability to be strategic and hands-on at once

- Executive presence at C-suite and board levels

- Collaborative, humble, and driven

- Passion for the transformative potential of conversational AI

Remote-first in the United States, with a strong preference for New York or San Francisco, where we have office spaces.

title: Lead / Principal Consultant - Data and AI
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team 

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Lead / Principal Consultant - Data and AI, who we refer to internally as Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects, pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers.

The Role 

As a Lead / Principal Consultant - Data and AI (referred to internally as a Lead / Principal Deployment Engineer) you are the backbone of Celonis delivery. You lead the hands-on implementation of Celonis solutions for enterprise customers, combining platform expertise with AI-augmented workflows to deliver high-quality outcomes, fast. You use Celonis’s AI deployment tools as your primary instruments - directing agents to build data models, generate analyses, and configure operational solutions, while applying your own judgment to validate outputs, adapt to customer context, and ensure business relevance.

This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are an AI-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer. You generate value by understanding the customer’s business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, and ensuring the platform delivers measurable impact. 

The Work You’ll Do 

Initiate and Connect 

- Conduct business discovery workshops to translate customers’ strategic objectives into high-impact Celonis use cases

- Collaborate with the customer’s IT and business stakeholders to define project scope, data requirements, and success criteria

- Ensure data connectivity and extraction pipelines are properly configured, working with specialist resources if required

Build & Value 

- Direct AI deployment agents (Apollo) to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards - writing clear specifications and validating agent outputs against business requirements

- Build and configure Celonis solutions across the platform: Process Intelligence Graph, data transformations, process analysis, operational solutions, and AI-powered insights

- Identify process inefficiencies and root causes using Celonis technology, always in close collaboration with the customer

- Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, business relevance, and alignment with customer context - applying domain knowledge where the AI cannot

- Lead value creation workshops and define measures to improve process inefficiencies

- Define and build KPIs measuring the customer’s success and quantify business impact

- Design and build operational solutions to drive value, adoption and improve process conformance

Rollout, Adoption, and Handover 

- Enable key customer users to use and extend the solution independently, setting the foundation for long-term adoption

- Manage project outcomes against timelines, scope, and customer expectations

- Train and demonstrate to customer users, guiding them on the path to sustained value

- Document solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and handoff

Domain & Industry Depth 

- Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals

- Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage

- Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap

What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era 

- You work with AI agents as your primary tools - your job is to direct, validate, and refine their output, not to write every line of code or build every analysis manually

- You need strong specification and context engineering skills - the ability to translate a customer’s ambiguous business need into a precise instruction that an AI agent can execute correctly

- You are expected to continuously learn and adapt as AI capabilities evolve, experimenting with new approaches and sharing what works with your peers

- You balance speed with quality - AI accelerates execution, but you own the judgment calls on whether the output is right for this customer

- You think in sustainable software solutions. While AI agents will generate first results quickly, you need to ensure that the operational solutions you build in Celonis are robust, user friendly, maintainable, and scalable

The Qualifications You Need 

- Experience: 7+ years minimum in Management or IT consulting, data/solution consulting, or process improvement consulting within software vendors, consulting firms, or system integrators.

- Platform skills: Ability to build and configure solutions on the Celonis platform, including data modeling, process analysis, KPI definition, and automation. Proficiency in PQL, SQL, and Python.

- AI fluency: Comfort working with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Ability to write clear specifications, evaluate AI-generated outputs, and iterate effectively. Experience with prompt engineering or context engineering is a strong plus.

- Business and process domain expertise : Strong understanding /deep expertise (based on seniority level) of enterprise business processes and financial metrics. Knowledge of standard ERPs (SAP, Oracle) and process areas (Inventory Management, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Accounts Payable) is a strong plus.

- Consulting skills: Ability to steer customer workshops, present findings to management, manage stakeholder expectations, and deliver outcomes in the face of adversity and ambiguity. Comfortable working with both technical and business audiences. 

- Analytical mindset: Excellent problem-solving skills with a value-driven orientation. Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and quantify business impact.

- Learning agility: Willingness to continuously develop expertise through experimentation. Comfort with ambiguity and evolving tools.

- Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Technology Management, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable field.

- Languages: Fluency in English and German required. 

- Travel : Willingness to travel to customer location up to 50%, according to customer requirement and project delivery phases.

What Celonis can offer you: 

- Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.

- Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.

- Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.

- Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.

- Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.

- Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.

- Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.

- Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

- Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us: 

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

The Role

AI Orchestration & Delivery Innovation

Customer Strategy & Advisory

- Review Solution(s) Blueprint to ensure quality, scalability and production readiness of business critical and operational use cases

Domain & Industry Depth

- Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage

- Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain in collaboration with the Deployment Engineer, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap

Practice Development

- Share knowledge across the organization through internal enablement sessions, documentation, and community of practice leadership

- Ensure the link with Product & Engineering to feed customer insights and field experience back into platform development, and to influence the platform roadmap

What Distinguishes This Role from Deployment Engineer 

- Scope: You work across multiple engagements and shape solutions across a portfolio/cluster/industry vertical (4+ concurrent clients)

- Influence & Practice Development: your Scope allows you to identify and set standards that other teams follow - for solution architecture, AI orchestration patterns, and delivery quality

- Bridge: You span pre-sales and post-sales, ensuring continuity between what’s sold and what’s delivered

- Force multiplier: Your work multiplies the effectiveness of Deployment Engineers rather than substituting for it

The Qualifications You Need

At least 3 years in a senior or lead technical role with multi-stakeholder responsibility in large-scale projects at tier-1 organizations (e.g. digital twin implementations, global AI transformations, near-real-time data pipelines, etc.)

Experience with context engineering, multi-agent system design, or AI validation at scale. Ability to define how AI should be used, not just use it.

Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager

As our Retail business continues to grow, we’re looking for a Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager to expand our selection of high-value regional retail partners. This role can be based in Berlin, Cologne, Frankfurt, Hamburg or Munich . 

What you’ll be doing 

In this role, you’ll own the acquisition and development of high-value regional Enterprise retail partners in Germany, from identifying and engaging the right prospects through commercial negotiations, signing and initial rollout. You’ll combine strong commercial execution with a strategic view on which partners can have the greatest impact on Wolt’s selection, coverage and long-term growth.

- Own the end-to-end sales cycle for regional Enterprise retail opportunities, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, contracting and signing.

- Lead complex commercial negotiations, balancing partner needs with sustainable economics and Wolt’s long-term business objectives.

- Build strong relationships with senior decision-makers and act as a trusted commercial partner throughout the sales process.

- Work closely with internal teams including Operations, Account Management, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Product to structure partnerships and enable successful launches.

- Take ownership beyond the signature, ensuring a strong handover and initial rollout so that newly acquired partners can successfully go live and scale.

- Use market insights, pipeline data and commercial learnings to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact accounts and continuously improve our regional Enterprise sales approach.

- Contribute to sharing best practices and raising the bar for Enterprise sales execution across the wider team.

Our humble expectations 

- You have significant experience in B2B sales, business development or strategic partnerships, ideally working with Enterprise or other complex, multi-stakeholder customers.

- You have a strong track record of independently managing and closing complex commercial opportunities from initial outreach through contract signature.

- You’re an excellent negotiator and understand how to build partnerships that create sustainable value for both sides.

- You combine a hands-on, results-oriented sales mindset with strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on their strategic impact.

What we offer 

This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in the next phase of Wolt’s Retail growth. You’ll have direct ownership of high-impact regional partnerships and the autonomy to take opportunities from first conversation all the way through to launch.

You’ll work at the intersection of sales, strategy and operations, collaborating with experienced colleagues across Wolt while building relationships with some of the most important retailers in the market. You’ll also join a fast-moving international environment where good ideas can quickly turn into action, with the tools, support and trust to take ownership of your work and make a visible impact.

About You 

We're looking for an Associate GTM Recruiter who is competitive, curious, and hungry to become exceptional at recruiting. At Constructor, we hire builders: people who take real ownership of their work, spot what needs fixing, and fix it without waiting to be asked. You'll bring that same mindset to how we hire.

Most of your time will go to sourcing and outreach: finding great people for our Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams and getting them excited to talk to us. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their recruiting career (or coming from an SDR/BDR seat) who wants real exposure, real responsibility, and a path to growing into a full-cycle recruiter.

About Us 

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we’ve built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We’re passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so.

Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.

We’re a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.

Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today.

About the Position 

You'll support hiring for Constructor's GTM teams, including Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, across North America, EMEA, APAC, and LATAM. You'll work closely with the Talent team and GTM leaders, learn the craft of recruiting hands-on, and take on more ownership as you grow.
