title: Head of Product (m/w/d)
description:
Über DrAnsay 

DrAnsay wurde 2018 gegründet und gehört heute zu den führenden digitalen Gesundheitsplattformen in Deutschland. Als digitales HealthTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Patient:innen, Ärzt:innen und Apotheken und entwickeln technologische Lösungen, die Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher, schneller und zugänglicher machen. Mehr als 1 Million Patient:innen nutzen unsere Plattform bereits. Unser Anspruch ist klar: digitale Medizin so zu gestalten, dass sie im Alltag wirklich funktioniert.

Wir arbeiten schnell, direkt und mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Wer zu uns kommt, übernimmt nicht einfach nur eine bestehende Rolle, sondern gestaltet Strukturen, Prozesse und Entscheidungen aktiv mit.

Warum es diese Rolle gibt 

DrAnsay befindet sich in einer Scale-up-Phase: Die Grundstrukturen der Produktorganisation stehen. Der Fokus liegt jetzt auf Optimierung, Effizienz und der Weiterentwicklung bestehender sowie neuer Produktinitiativen. Unser CPO verantwortet gleichzeitig kommerzielle und strategische Themen der Unternehmensführung. Neue Initiativen brauchen deshalb eine Person, die produktübergreifend Struktur schafft und den Takt hält.

Die Position wird neu geschaffen, um diese Lücke zu schließen. Das ist keine Rolle, in der du Grundlagen aufräumst. Es geht darum, dass wir neue Produkte schneller starten und bei bestehenden Produkten an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten.

Deine Rolle 

Als Head of Product übernimmst du die Koordination produktübergreifender Roadmaps und OKR-Zyklen, verantwortest das unternehmensweite Produkt-Reporting und sorgst dafür, dass Metriken, Feature-Impact und Produktstrategie intern klar kommuniziert werden. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO und bist Schnittstelle zu einem neunköpfigen Produktteam aus Senior Product Managern und einem UX-Team sowie zu Data, Marketing und Engineering.

Dein Ziel in den ersten Monaten ist es, alle Produktbereiche, unseren Markt und das Team gründlich zu verstehen. Du erkennst, wo Planung, Zusammenarbeit und Dokumentation besser werden können, machst einen Plan und setzt ihn um.

Was du konkret machst 

- Produktübergreifende Roadmaps über mehrere Produktlinien und Teams hinweg koordinieren, aktuell halten und Abhängigkeiten zwischen Teams früh erkennen und auflösen

- OKRs und Key Results auf Team-Ebene mit der übergeordneten Produktstrategie verknüpfen und die Zyklen von der Planung bis zur Auswertung begleiten

- Die Produkt-Metriken und das unternehmensweite Reporting zum Feature-Impact verantworten, gemeinsam mit unserem Data-Team

- Vorhaben hinterfragen, die zu wenig Kunden- oder Geschäftswert schaffen, und Alternativen vorschlagen

- User Research strukturiert in laufende Produktentwicklung einbinden, gemeinsam mit unserem Head of UX und dem UX-Team

- Die Arbeitsweise unserer Product Manager weiterentwickeln, besonders Planung, Dokumentation und Reporting

- Product Discovery und die frühe Teamstrukturierung neuer Produktinitiativen unterstützen, inklusive Abstimmung mit Engineering

- Die unternehmensweite Kommunikation zur Produktstrategie aufbauen und Produktentscheidungen für alle nachvollziehbar dokumentieren

Das brauchst du 

- Erfahrung in einer Product-Leadership-Rolle, etwa als Head of Product, Product Lead oder Group Product Manager. Du hast über dein eigenes Produkt hinaus Verantwortung getragen, für mehrere Product Manager, Teams oder Produktbereiche, fachlich oder disziplinarisch

- Erfahrung mit digitalen Produkten für Endkund:innen (B2C) in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen

- Praxis mit OKRs und Roadmapping: Du hast OKR-Zyklen produktübergreifend koordiniert und Roadmaps für mehrere Teams gepflegt und kommuniziert

- Sicherer Umgang mit Produktkennzahlen: Du hast Metriken definiert, Feature-Impact gemessen und Reporting für interne Stakeholder aufgebaut

- Du überzeugst über Argumente und Zahlen, nicht über deine Position, und diskutierst auch mit erfahrenen Product Managern auf Augenhöhe

- Die Bereitschaft, auch die Strukturarbeit selbst zu machen: Roadmaps pflegen, Updates einfordern, Reporting am Laufen halten

- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens C1), weil du täglich in beiden Sprachen mit Product, Engineering und Leadership arbeitest

- Du kannst die Tätigkeit dauerhaft aus Deutschland ausüben und verfügst zum Start über die hierfür erforderliche Arbeitserlaubnis

Das fällt positiv auf 

- Erfahrung als Head of Product. Voraussetzung ist sie nicht

- Mehrjährige eigene Produktverantwortung als Product Manager, bevor du in eine Leadership-Rolle gewechselt bist

- Erfahrung aus einer größeren Produktorganisation mit ausgereiften Arbeitsweisen

- Erfahrung mit Roadmap- und Produktmanagement-Tools wie airfocus, Productboard, Jira Product Discovery oder Aha!

- Erfahrung mit Produktanalyse-Tools wie PostHog, Amplitude oder Mixpanel

- Produkterfahrung in E-Commerce, Marktplätzen oder Digital Health

- Erfahrung in stark regulierten Produktumfeldern

- Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit UX-Teams und der Einbindung von User Research

Was wir bieten 

- Vollzeit und unbefristet, Start ab November 2026

- 100% Remote: Du arbeitest aus Deutschland, Vollzeit, ohne Standortbindung

- Eine Rolle, die mitwächst: Je tiefer dein Verständnis von Produkten, Markt und Team, desto mehr Entscheidungen übernimmst du

- Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem CPO und Zeit, alle Produktbereiche gründlich kennenzulernen

- Sichtbare Wirkung: Du prägst, wie DrAnsay neue Produkte startet und woran das Product-Team arbeitet

- Kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen, Low-Ego-Kultur und direktem Feedback

- Ein Produkt mit realem Nutzen: Wir helfen täglich Menschen, Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher zu bekommen

Wie du dich bewirbst 

Bewirb dich direkt über das Bewerbungsformular. Kein Anschreiben erforderlich, wir stellen dir einige kurze Fragen, die uns helfen zu verstehen, wie du arbeitest. Diese Antworten sind uns wichtiger als dein LinkedIn-Profil.

Du hörst von uns innerhalb von fünf Arbeitstagen. 

DrAnsay ist ein chancengleicher Arbeitgeber. Bewerbungen werden auf Basis von Qualifikationen und Berufserfahrung bewertet. Alle Bewerbenden werden unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Herkunft, Behinderung, Religion oder anderen geschützten Merkmalen berücksichtigt. DrAnsay verarbeitet die mit deiner Bewerbung übermittelten personenbezogenen Daten zur Durchführung des Recruitingprozesses.

title: Projektleiter / Teamleiter (m/w/d)
description:
VOLLZEIT | DONNERSDORF | 4.000 € BIS 5.000 € BRUTTO PRO MONAT 

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

- 4.000 € bis 5.000 € brutto monatlich abhängig von Erfahrung und Qualifikation

- Eine verantwortungsvolle Führungsrolle mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum

- Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und kurze Entscheidungswege

- Ein eingespieltes, wertschätzendes Umfeld mit klarer operativer Ausrichtung

- Verantwortung für laufende Kundenprojekte im industriellen Umfeld

- Vielseitige Aufgaben zwischen Führung, Planung, Prozesssteuerung und Qualitätsverantwortung

- Entwicklungsperspektiven in einem wachsenden Unternehmen

- Einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz mit langfristiger Perspektive

ÜBERNIMM VERANTWORTUNG, WO LEISTUNG ENTSTEHT

Du hast bereits Verantwortung in Produktion, Industrie, Logistik oder einem vergleichbaren operativen Umfeld übernommen und möchtest Teams nicht nur verwalten, sondern aktiv weiterentwickeln?

Dann werde Teil unseres Teams als Projektleiter (m/w/d) .

Du übernimmst die operative Verantwortung für ein Kundenprojekt im logistischen Umfeld. Dabei sorgst du für stabile Abläufe, eine verlässliche Personalplanung sowie die Erreichung von Qualitäts-, Produktivitäts- und Leistungszielen.

Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Mitarbeitenden, Kundenansprechpartnern und Geschäftsführung – mit dem Anspruch, Herausforderungen nicht nur zu melden, sondern nachhaltig zu lösen.

DEINE AUFGABEN

- Du übernimmst die operative Führung eines Logistikteams bei einem unserer Kundenprojekte.

- Du steuerst Personal-, Einsatz- und Kapazitätsplanung und stellst eine verlässliche Projektbesetzung sicher.

- Du sorgst dafür, dass Produktionsziele, Qualitätsvorgaben und vereinbarte Kennzahlen erreicht werden.

- Du analysierst Prozesse, erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und setzt praktikable Optimierungen um.

- Du steuerst relevante Kennzahlen wie Produktivität, Ausschuss, Qualität, Anwesenheit und Leistungserfüllung.

- Du entwickelst dein Team fachlich und organisatorisch weiter und führst neue Mitarbeitende strukturiert ein.

- Du stellst eine klare Kommunikation zwischen Mitarbeitenden, Kundenansprechpartnern und Geschäftsführung sicher.

- Du reagierst souverän auf Abweichungen, Engpässe und kurzfristige operative Herausforderungen.

- Du dokumentierst Leistungen, Entwicklungen und relevante Abweichungen nachvollziehbar.

- Du bist regelmäßig auf der Fläche präsent und gehst als Führungskraft voran.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer Führungsfunktion in Produktion, Industrie, Metallverarbeitung, Gießerei, Logistik oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld.

- Erfahrung als Produktionsleiter, Projektleiter, Teamleiter, Lagerleiter, Schichtleiter, Vorarbeiter oder Gruppenleiter.

- Gute Kenntnisse in der Steuerung von Produktionsabläufen, Personalplanung und operativen Kennzahlen.

- Ein gutes Gespür für Menschen sowie die Fähigkeit, Teams verbindlich, fair und klar zu führen.

- Eine strukturierte, pragmatische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.

- Durchsetzungsstärke, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität.

- Kommunikationsstärke im Kontakt mit Kunden, Mitarbeitenden und internen Schnittstellen.

- Führerschein Klasse B.

- Projektbezogene Reisebereitschaft.

WARUM DIESE POSITION?

Diese Rolle ist für Menschen, die operative Führung ernst nehmen. Du gestaltest nicht aus der Distanz, sondern direkt dort, wo Leistung entsteht.

Du hast sichtbaren Einfluss auf Abläufe, Qualität, Produktivität und die Entwicklung deines Teams. Gleichzeitig arbeitest du eng mit unseren Kunden und der Geschäftsführung zusammen und kannst Prozesse aktiv weiterentwickeln.

KLINGT NACH DIR?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung, wenn du die genannten Muss-Kriterien erfüllst und bereit bist, bundesweit Verantwortung in unseren Kundenprojekten zu übernehmen.

Sende deine Bewerbungsunterlagen einfach über unser Bewerbungsformular oder per E-Mail an Miguel Schäuble
+49 (0)160 902 151 88
Die TABEL Gruppe ist ein führendes Dienstleistungsunternehmen im Bereich Business Process Outsourcing im fertigungsnahen Umfeld.

Von der Prozessanalyse über die Projektkonzeption bis zur Umsetzung und Begleitung steht das Erreichen der Produktivitätsziele unserer Kunden im Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns.

Mit rund 3.000 Mitarbeitenden an über 30 Standorten unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, Kosten zu senken, ihre Wettbewerbsfähigkeit zu stärken und sich auf ihre Kernkompetenzen zu konzentrieren. Wir hinterfragen Bestehendes, um Prozesse nachhaltig besser zu gestalten – mit Erfahrung, bewährten Methoden, Transparenz und innovativen Lösungen.

What decides whether we make money is the quality of the inputs our algorithms run on: forecasts of prices, market fundamentals and renewable generation - from long-term views down to intraday and real time.

- You develop and implement analytical, statistical and fundamental models to assess European power and renewable markets and deliver data-driven insights and signals for our trading decisions
- You assess market trends and new markets quantitatively, providing the basis for country and product decisions
- You lead a team of 5-7 analysts & data scientist, develop them technically and coach them in their personal growth
- You work closely with Trading Desk, Portfolio Management & Pricing, Sales and Product, building the bridge to develop cutting edge products and services
- You create reports, monitorings and benchmarks to derive actionable insights for trading, senior management and other stakeholders
- Your models feed into bids and prices largely automatically, and into the decisions of the management board

Who you are - Several years of experience in quantitative analysis on European power markets — price, fundamental and renewable generation forecasting as well as fundamental modelling.
- A solid understanding of day-ahead, intraday and ancillary services, capacity and local flexibility markets, and of how prices form in them
- Experience in technical leadership — or a clearly visible step towards it — with the ability to motivate and develop a team
- The ability to translate quantitative findings so that the management board and stakeholders can make decisions based on them
- business-fluent English and German is a plus

We’re building that in Heidelberg.

We are hiring a Senior AI Researcher to join our Pre-training team and to advance the architecture and training of our next generation of foundation models. If you are excited about designing inference-efficient architectures, optimising training recipes that scale reliably, and training models on a large scale cluster (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs), we would love to hear from you.

Team Culture 

We foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. As a Senior AI Researcher in Pre-training (f/m/d) , you will own the critical technical levers that determine the success of our next-generation models: architecture, optimization, stability, and scaling. 

Working at the high-leverage intersection of research and engineering, you will translate mathematical reasoning and empirical observations into principled training decisions - from small-scale proxy experiments to multi-thousand-GPU runs.

- Stability, Diagnostics & Debugging: Investigate complex convergence issues (loss spikes, divergence) and resolve hard-to-reproduce distributed system failures like communication bottlenecks, race conditions, and synchronization errors.

- You are proficient in Python and deeply familiar with PyTorch-based training workflows.

description:

We are looking for an Avionics Engineer to design, build, test, and support the electronic systems that enable our launch vehicles to operate. We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

- Develop avionics electronics for flight hardware, including power, control, sensing, instrumentation, telemetry, and data-acquisition systems.

- Design, build, and maintain electrical ground-support equipment, test fixtures, harnesses, and facility interfaces.

- Bring up, debug, integrate, and verify electronic hardware in the laboratory, on test stands, and on vehicle hardware.

- Work closely with flight software, systems, propulsion, mechanical, manufacturing, and test teams to resolve cross-disciplinary issues.

- Support environmental testing, hardware campaigns, launch operations, and the continuous improvement of avionics designs and processes.

What we are looking for

- A degree in electrical engineering, electronics engineering, avionics, computer engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience may also be relevant.

- Experience designing, developing, testing, or integrating complex electronic hardware in aerospace, space, defence, automotive, robotics, or another high-reliability environment.

- Strong understanding of analogue and digital electronics, power distribution, sensors, signal conditioning, and hardware interfaces.

- Practical experience with schematics, PCB development, component selection, laboratory testing, and technical documentation.

- A methodical approach to requirements, verification, fault finding, configuration control, and hardware safety.

- The ability to work hands-on and independently while collaborating effectively across a small, fast-moving engineering team.

Desirable experience

- Flight hardware for launch vehicles, spacecraft, aircraft, missiles, or other safety-critical aerospace systems.

- Electrical ground-support equipment, test stands, instrumentation, data acquisition, harnessing, or vehicle integration.

- Embedded electronics, microcontrollers, communication interfaces, telemetry systems, or hardware-software integration.

- Environmental, vibration, thermal, electromagnetic compatibility, or qualification testing.

- ECAD tools such as Altium, KiCad, or similar, together with experience taking hardware into production.

- Experience with aerospace quality processes, component derating, FMEA, reliability analysis, or formal verification and validation.

title: Senior QA Engineer (All genders)
description:
About us 

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com . 

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. Having grown 10x in the past year, we are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel. Backed by four leading VCs (TQ Ventures, Creandum, Northzone, and Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80 m Series C, we are ready to push beyond.

The opportunity 

We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer that will take an active role in shaping our QA strategy. You will also be responsible for the improvement of delivered features to production, reducing the number of user complaints and ensuring that the product delivered has top-notch quality. One of the main goals of the team is preventing bugs that have the potential to impact the production environment and affect sales / crucial functionality times. 

What you will do: 

- Improvement of delivered features to production, reducing the number of user complaints and ensuring that the product delivered has top-notch quality 

- Development of an automated test framework from scratch 

- Integration tests, end-to-end tests, functional tests, regression tests 

- Preventing bugs that have the potential to impact the production environment, affect sales and crucial functionality 

- Microservices and API use cases (Postman, SOAP, REST) 

- Creation of test case scenarios for manual and automated tests 

- Development and execution of manual test case scenarios 

- Independent investigation and proposal of new methods for improving quality assurance processes 

- Reporting and documentation of all discovered errors/bugs 

- Close collaboration with cross-functional teams to deliver tasks on time and to the expected quality. 

Workplace: Berlin & Hybrid

We are aiming to hire a professional based in Germany or Europe. We are a remote-first company with colleagues based around the Globe.

Who you are: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 

- At least 5 years of experience in software quality assurance and test automation, including developing automated test scripts using JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or Ruby. 

- Experience with test automation frameworks such as Cypress, Selenium, or similar tools (experience with JEST is a plus). 

- Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, QA methodologies, testing processes, and test design principles. 

- Experience designing test strategies and test plans across multiple teams or products, with the ability to establish scalable QA processes. 

- Proven experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. 

- Strong experience testing APIs and integrations using tools such as Postman, REST APIs, SOAP, and Swagger/OpenAPI. 

- Experience testing functional, integration, and end-to-end scenarios across web applications. Experience with mobile testing (e.g. Appium) is a plus.

Wir denken Energie neu: tech-driven, kundenzentriert, agil. Die Rolle 
Wir bündeln unsere kommerziellen Bereiche unter einer Führung, um die nächste Wachstumsphase zu treiben. Als Commercial Director verantwortest du unsere gesamte kommerzielle Strategie, von Vertriebskanälen über Kundenbindung bis hin zu Produktentwicklung und Partnerschaften. Du bist Teil unseres Senior Management Teams und arbeitest direkt mit CEO und CFO an der strategischen Steuerung des Unternehmens.

Deine Verantwortung 
Commercial Strategy & Performance 

- Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer kohärenten Commercial-Strategie über alle Vertriebskanäle hinweg: Field Sales, Online/Direct, Preisvergleichsportale und Partnerschaften

- Ownership der zentralen Unit Economics und Kanal-Profitabilität – mit dem Ziel, den optimalen Kanal-Mix kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln

- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Pricing, Marketing und Produkt über Matrixstrukturen – du steuerst die kommerziellen KPIs bereichsübergreifend

- Woche für Woche Anpassung der Strategie auf Basis von Marktdynamiken, Wettbewerbsbewegungen und Kundenverhalten

Kundenbindung & Customer Lifetime Value 

- Ownership der Retention-Strategie: Kohortenanalysen, Preissensitivität, Angebotsgestaltung und optimales Timing

- Fachliche Steuerung der Retention-Aktivitäten in Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing (Lifecycle-Kommunikation) und Pricing

- Vorantreiben der Automatisierung und Skalierung von Kundenbindungsprozessen auf unserer Technologieplattform

Produkte, Innovation & Skalierung 

- Kommerzielle Bewertung und Skalierung neuer Produkte und Tarife – mit dem Blick auf Unit Economics, Product-Market Fit und Skalierbarkeit

- Steuerung des Weges vom Pilotprojekt zum skalierbaren Produkt – mit unternehmerischem Urteilsvermögen, nicht nur Projektmanagement

- Entwicklung von Cross-Selling- und Bundling-Strategien über unsere Geschäftsbereiche (energy retail, flexibility, low carbon tech, mobility) hinweg

Vertrieb & Partnerschaften 

- Direkte Führungsverantwortung für Vertriebsteams und das Partnerships-Team – Fokus auf Produktivität, Effizienz und Wachstum

- Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Vertriebsplattform-Strategie

- Aufbau und Management strategischer Partnerschaften mit Marktpartnern und Plattformen

Führung & Zusammenarbeit 

- Teil des Senior Management Teams, gemeinsam mit CEO, CFO und den Directors für Tech, Marketing, Operations und People

- Führung mehrerer Teams mit direkter und indirekter Verantwortung über Matrixstrukturen

- Enger Austausch mit dem globalen Octopus-Netzwerk für Best Practices und gemeinsame Initiativen

Dein Profil 

- 
8–12 Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon signifikante Zeit in einer Scale-up-Umgebung mit B2C-Fokus – z.B. Telko, Fintech, Insurance, Subscription-Modelle oder vergleichbare Märkte

- 
Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in einer Querschnittsrolle mit P&L-Verantwortung über mehrere Bereiche – du hast bewiesen, dass du viele Themen parallel treiben kannst

Datengetrieben, aber nicht datenabhängig: Du verstehst Analytics als Steuerungstool, stellst die richtigen Fragen und kannst idealerweise auch selbst in Daten eintauchen – triffst aber genauso Entscheidungen, wenn die Datenlage nicht perfekt ist

- 
Hands-on-Mentalität: Du bist bereit, operativ tief einzusteigen, und entwickelst gleichzeitig die übergreifende Strategie

Erfahrung in der Führung über Matrixstrukturen – du mobilisierst Teams auch dort, wo du nicht disziplinarisch führst

title: Senior Funnel Specialist (m/w/d)
description:
Stellenbeschreibung Die meisten Copywriter schreiben Sätze, die gut klingen. Wir suchen jemanden, der Sätze schreibt, die verkaufen.

Wenn du eine Anzeige liest und sofort siehst, welcher Hook zieht, welcher Angle trägt und wo der Leser aussteigt, bevor er kauft — dann lies weiter. Wenn dir "kreativ schreiben" nicht reicht und du wissen willst, warum ein Satz konvertiert und der andere nicht — dann erst recht.

Pammys ist in nur vier Jahren auf über eine Million Kund:innen gewachsen und wurde von Financial Times und Statista als eines der am schnellsten wachsenden E-Commerce-Unternehmen Europas ausgezeichnet. Mit einem über 150-köpfigen Team an unseren Standorten Hamburg und Kiel sowie einem eigenen rund 22.000 m² großen Logistikzentrum in Lensahn bauen wir die führende Footwear- und Fashion-Brand Europas weiter aus.

Unser klares Ziel: von aktuell mittleren achtstelligen auf neunstellige Jahresumsätze zu skalieren. Damit das gelingt, müssen wir immer neue Menschen erreichen, ihr Vertrauen gewinnen und sie vom Kauf überzeugen — auf Wegen, die wir bisher noch nicht gegangen sind.

Dafür suchen wir einen Senior Funnel Specialist (m/w/d) , der bzw. die die komplette Funnel-Journey von der ersten Anzeige bis zum Kaufabschluss textlich verantwortet.

Deine Aufgaben - Du schreibst Werbeanzeigen, Produkttexte und Website-Copy entlang der gesamten Journey: Werbeanzeige → Produktseite → Kauf
- Du denkst Performance Marketing als Psychologie – du überzeugst emotional UND rational, nicht "wie im Retail"
- Du baust mit deinen Texten Autorität und Vertrauen auf (Social Proof, ggf. Referenzen bekannter Stimmen der Branche)
- Du entwickelst mit uns neue Content-Funnel-Formate, die wir bisher noch nicht genutzt haben: Advertorials, Listicles und Native Ads (z. B. über Online-Magazine) – mit Call-to-Action nach einem informierenden Beitrag statt klassischer Anzeige
- Du erzählst ein relatable Storytelling rund um unseren USP
- Du sorgst mit Vertrauenselementen (z. B. Klarna, PayPal) auf unserer Website dafür, dass Kaufbarrieren fallen
- Du versetzt dich tief in die Bedürfnisse unserer Zielgruppe hinein und schreibst konsequent in unserer Markenstimme
- Du musst Media Buying nicht selbst operativ umsetzen – aber du verstehst, wie Facebook Ads grundsätzlich funktionieren, und denkst wie jemand, der selbst kaufen würde

Dein Profil - Du bringst ca. 3 Jahre Erfahrung als Copywriter im Marketing mit (Produkttexte, Website-Texte o. Ä.)
- Du hast ausgezeichnete Deutsch- UND Englischkenntnisse
- Du hast bereits als Creative Strategist, Media Buyer oder Copywriter gearbeitet (oder eine Kombination daraus)
- Du recherchierst gründlich, schreibst kreativ und verstehst die Psychologie hinter einer Kaufentscheidung
- Du hast ein Grundverständnis von Media Buying / wie Facebook Ads funktionieren
- Idealerweise hast du bereits in Branchen mit starker Direct-Response-Tradition getextet
- Du bringst solide EDV-Kenntnisse mit
- Deiner Bewerbung fügst du eine Arbeitsprobe bzw. ein Portfolio bei (z. B. Listicles, eigene Werbetexte) – deine Texte sagen uns mehr als dein Lebenslauf

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich deinem Leben anpassen
- Großzügiges Weiterbildungsbudget für deine persönliche Entwicklung
- Eine Kultur, in der deine Meinung zählt und Wertschätzung gelebt wird
- Kurze Entscheidungswege: Weniger Bürokratie, keine endlosen Meetings
- Moderne, zentrale Offices in Hamburg und Kiel
- Dein Setup, deine Wahl – Laptop oder MacBook, dazu ein iPhone

title: Senior Motor Fleet Underwriter
description:
ABOUT FLOCK 

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger.

THE ROLE 

At Flock, we’re transforming the motor fleet insurance landscape with cutting-edge technology and data-driven insights. As a Senior Motor Fleet Underwriter, you’ll play a pivotal role in our mission to deliver smarter, safer, and more cost-effective insurance solutions. You’ll leverage advanced analytics and AI to assess risk, optimise underwriting processes, and create tailored policies that meet the unique needs of our clients. Your expertise will drive our growth, helping us build a future where innovation and excellence in insurance are the norm. If you’re passionate about making an impact, thrive in a dynamic startup environment, and are ready to lead the charge in redefining fleet insurance, we want you on our team!

WHAT WE THINK IS MOST EXCITING ABOUT THE ROLE: 

You’ll have the autonomy to manage and develop a large business portfolio, mentor junior team members, and significantly contribute to team targets. You’ll help unlock growth into new market segments, offering insurance solutions for emerging mobility trends, and support our ambition to become one of the UK’s largest fleet MGAs. Your expertise will drive growth and innovation, positioning us at the forefront of the fleet insurance industry. You’ll also work with AI in the underwriting process itself, using it to pull risk data out of submissions and triage cases faster, which leaves your time for the judgement calls that need an experienced underwriter.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO FLOCK 

ESSENTIAL 

- Extensive experience underwriting motor fleet insurance 

- Track record of building strong and supportive relationships with insurance brokers

- The ability to collate data and provide support to our Head of Underwriting to enable them to monitor and analyse the portfolio

- Provide feedback and continuously improve the process for gathering risk information from our clients, in order to ensure frictionless quoting and onboarding for all clients and brokers

- Identify and surface to our Underwriting Manager areas where we can improve our policy wording and coverage

- Follow rapidly evolving market trends, continuously refurbishing your knowledge of cutting-edge products and services in the Motor Fleet

- Actively train and develop members of the Underwriting and operations teams and to help promote Underwriting knowledge across Flock

- Comfortable using AI in underwriting work, for example extracting and checking risk information or speeding up quoting, while keeping your own judgement on every decision

PREFERABLE 

- Experience in dealing with large corporate customers 

- ACII qualified or working towards

- Experience of working closely with product teams to ensure product, process and customer journey enhancements are included within the product roadmap

WHAT WE OFFER (in addition to a competitive salary) 

- 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖 

- Share Incentive Plan 📈

- Workplace Pension 💰

- Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

- Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

- Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

- £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

- £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

- 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

ONE LAST THING.. 

Authenticity is important to us. We value the unique qualities and experiences you bring. So if you apply, just be your genuine self. It’s who we want!

- Own the tool layer: how WPP and third-party capabilities are exposed to agents through well-defined interfaces, contracts, permissions and connectivity standards such as MCP.

- Lead the agentification of WPP applications, working with the teams that own them to make their capabilities callable, observable and safe to operate agentically.

- Define the guardrails (what an agent may do, on whose authority, with what data), working with Agent Governance so they are built into the product.

- Own the evaluation and quality approach for skills and for chained agent output: how capability is tested before release and monitored after it.

- Define the data and context strategy that agents reason over, spanning retrieval, grounding, memory, context management and the interfaces to WPP's data and knowledge assets.

- Provide day-to-day vision, direction and motivation to the cross-functional product team, including product management, data analysts, engineers and product enablement.

- Use data to drive product strategies and plans, gathering quantitative and qualitative feedback from stakeholders and systems to enhance product adoption and usage continually.

- Deep and current knowledge of agent architectures: LLMs, tool, skill and function calling, RAG and retrieval design, context & memory management, multi-agent orchestration, and connectivity standards such as MCP.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
We’re on a mission to back the UK’s small businesses like no one else 🚀

Small businesses are the backbone of the economy, and we’re here to help them win. We’ve built a platform that uses clever data to get them the funding they need in minutes, not weeks.

At Funding Circle, we have the restless energy of a fintech start-up with the stability of a public company. It’s a unique mix that gives Circlers the autonomy to take ownership and the scale to make an impact that truly counts.

We’re a high-performing team that chooses to lift each other up. We challenge, we champion, and we have each other’s backs - because we know that when we stand together, we move faster and build better.

The impact is real: Last year alone, the businesses on our platform generated £7.2bn for the UK economy 📈 Come and join a mission that matters! 

[ Read our Impact Report ] | [ See our Trustpilot ]

The role ⚡

📍 London (Hybrid) | 🤝 2 days in the office | 💰 Competitive Salary + Benefits

As Principal Data Engineer you are the primary technical authority for Funding Circle's Data Engineering and Data Platform architecture, designing innovative solutions on Snowflake and AWS. Reporting to the VP of Data and sitting on the Data Leadership Team, you lead the analysis, architecture, design and development of our Data and Analytics estate.

You own the Data Platform strategy and the multi-phased roadmap to our Future State Data Platform, and you are the key technical team member advising on the migration to the Future State Data Platform.

- Own the Data Platform strategy and execute the multi-phased roadmap for migrating to the Future State Data Platform on Snowflake and AWS, advising on migration architecture, transition states, historical data migration and legacy decommissioning.

- Lead the architecture, design and development of scalable cloud data warehouse, lakehouse, streaming and analytics solutions.

- Define ingestion, transformation and orchestration patterns, naming and structural conventions, and the publication boundary between Product Engineering and Data Engineering.

- Identify, mitigate and resolve architectural bottlenecks, control weaknesses and technical debt across the data ecosystem.

- Own the Data as a Product Community of Practice and the standards that bind every Data Product: metadata and data contract specifications, output port and schema design, data product versioning, DQ requirements, SLA and SLO declarations, and semantic layer conventions

- Champion data quality, lineage, observability and governance, ensuring checks, SLAs and alerting are expressed as code and monitored in production rather than asserted on a page.

- As a key member of the Data Architecture Review Board, work on and carry formal decision rights over data architecture decisions, ensuring every proposal is engineering-viable, consistent with the platform direction and properly recorded.

What we’re looking for 🌱

Purpose of the role 

As Head of Pricing - Insurance at Zego, you will lead the insurer’s technical view of the models that drive our pricing. That covers the actuarial risk models behind our net rates, the demand and market models, and any other predictive model used for pricing and underwriting decisions. The models are built by the MGA pricing teams using a mix of traditional techniques (GLM, GAM, GBM) as well as new AI driven approaches.

Your role is to make sure that we, as the insurer, can form an actuarial view on all of them, validate what sits underneath, and stand behind the rates it carries. On the actuarial risk models you will go further still, joining those projects from the start and owning the independent validation end to end.

You will do this as the senior technical voice in a small actuarial team, which brings real breadth alongside the depth. Alongside the models you will review pricing and underwriting proposals across both personal and commercial motor in close collaboration with our underwriting team, and you will bring the modelling view into portfolio management.

You will work directly with the MGA pricing teams, with underwriting and with our co-insurance partners, with access to senior leadership and to decision making from the first week.

What you will be working on 

- Lead the insurer’s technical view across the full model landscape: the actuarial risk models, the demand models, the market and optimisation models. For each one the questions are the same: is the approach sound, can the output be trusted, and are we using it the way we intend to.

- Bring an actuarial view to all modelling approaches including AI driven models. Methods move quickly, you need to keep up.

- Go deeper on the actuarial risk models that set our net rates: join each project, independently validate the modelling decisions, the rating factor choices and the assumptions applied, and evidence the basis for each.

- Review, validate and challenge pricing and underwriting proposals across personal and commercial lines, working closely with our underwriting team: tactical pricing changes, full model updates, optimisation algorithms, new underwriting rules and renewal capping.

- Contribute to portfolio management and portfolio insight: what the KPIs are telling us, what is driving the movements, and what the modelling view says about where performance is heading.

- Support the insurer’s position with our co-insurance partners on the net rates, the quality of the models behind them and the validation we have carried out.

- Mentor and coach junior actuarial colleagues.

- Help build the processes, the governance and the tooling, including AI, that allow a small and senior team to work faster and more robustly.

What you will need to be successful in the role 

- A qualified actuary, or an equivalent track record inside an actuarial pricing team, with at least ten years of hands-on modelling experience.

- Deep experience of classic actuarial risk modelling: GLMs built in Emblem, Akur8 or equivalent, with Python used in practice rather than in principle.

title: Product Engineer (Backend)

We're building a category-defining product, backed by a $125M Series C and used daily by teams at companies like Cursor, Vanta, and Linear. We started by making meeting notes better. If you haven't already, you should check out what we're building , and why you should work here .

The role 

You'll own the systems that make Granola fast, accurate and trustworthy for the next 100x of users, and you'll help decide what's worth building. Our backend engineers talk to users and ship product, not just services.

What you'll work on 

- The voice pipeline. Scale real-time transcription so notes land accurately in seconds, on every device people use.

- New models in production. Evaluate new voice and transcription models as they're released, and get the best ones into users' hands.

- The agent harness. Build the harness Granola's agents run in: long-running jobs, tool calls, retries, and retrieving the right context.

- APIs and integrations. Extend the APIs and integrations that let people bring Granola context into the AI tools they already use.

- Enterprise-grade trust. Build the permissions, data isolation and admin controls that let a company roll Granola out across every team.

- Data at scale. Own Postgres performance, observability and alerting as usage grows.

How we work 

- People and product first. We hire people who are kind, down to earth and pragmatic, who care deeply about the product, and who want to stay connected to the customers using it. Product isn't one team's job here; it's everyone's.

- High autonomy. Engineers spot opportunities and ship improvements themselves. We’d rather you ship it than write about it.

- Everyone talks to users. Every engineer works directly with the people using Granola, and that's where most of our best ideas come from.

- A high bar for engineering and product. We expect strong technical ability and strong product sense. Engineers think like PMs: they understand the user's problem and help shape the direction of what they build.

- Room to experiment. Every engineer has a budget from day one to use new models, tools and technologies which make them more productive.

- Design and quality matter. Thoughtful design, a high quality bar and close collaboration on everything we build.

- We work in person, with flexibility. We’re in the office five days a week because we genuinely like building together. It’s relaxed: dress down, bring your dog, and no fixed office hours.

What that looks like in practice: the version of Granola we use internally goes far beyond the public app. We're building at the frontier of agentic software, and we try every new capability on ourselves first.

The team 

The Granola team is kind, curious and design-obsessed. Many of us are former founders, others have built products at Figma, Apple, Google and Meta, and we're all still learning from each other.

Who we're looking for 

We don't set a minimum number of years. Some of our strongest engineers graduated two years ago; others have run their own companies. We care about what you've built and how you think about it.

- You've owned backend systems in production that real users depended on, and you can talk through the trade-offs you made.

- You're strong in TypeScript and Node.js.

- You know relational databases deeply (we use Postgres): query plans, indexing, and migrations without downtime.

- You're comfortable with cloud infrastructure as code (we use AWS, Terraform and a lot of Lambda).

- You think about security and failure modes before the happy path.

- You have product sense: you can explain why a system matters to the person using it, and you'd rather ship what users need this week than the perfect version next quarter.

Bonus: experience with speech or audio pipelines, LLM infrastructure, evals, or streaming systems.

Our stack 

TypeScript, Node.js, Postgres, AWS (with plenty of Lambda), Terraform, plus whichever new models and tools prove themselves. You don't need experience with everything, but you should be excited to work close to the product and at real scale.

How we hire 

Our interviews start with the product: who the user is, what problem matters and what you'd build first. Throughout, we're looking for product sense, good judgement on trade-offs, real engineering depth, and how you'd use your experience to shape a product from the ground up. We also look for people who ship quickly, iterate and love to experiment, and who stay kind and pragmatic along the way.

What we offer 

We're living in the most exciting time for tool builders since Engelbart's demo in 1968, and we want to build that future together in London. We pay slightly above market on salary and above market on equity. We work together in person five days a week at our office in Old Street, and we offer relocation support if you're moving to London.

Great people come from all kinds of backgrounds. If this speaks to you, whether or not you look like a fit on paper, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior HW Engineer – Signal and Power Integrity
description:
The Opportunity 

Every board Lumai builds has to run multi-gigabit links and feed high-current ASIC and FPGA rails. Getting those right before the board is fabricated is the difference between a working system and a respin cycle. This role owns the modelling, the stackups, the materials and the design rules that make it work, and has a direct say in the decisions that prevent the respin.

The Role 

You will own signal and power integrity across our boards and packages. That means pre-layout channel studies that set routing topologies, stackups, materials and constraints; post-layout analysis of critical channels, including insertion and return loss, crosstalk, and eye and COM analysis with IBIS-AMI models; optimisation of vias, breakouts, connector launches and the transitions into our optical engines; and PDN impedance targets, decoupling strategies and DC drop analysis for high-current rails.

What is genuinely hard is that the channels cross boundaries - chip, package, interposer, board and optical engine - and a model is only as good as its weakest corner. You will spend as much time at the bench as in the tool, correlating what you predicted against what the hardware does, and feeding that back into design rules.

By month six, you will have signed off the critical channels on at least one board, built the model libraries and design guidelines the team reuses, and be the person whose analysis decides when a layout is ready to release.

What You'll Do 

- Run pre-layout channel studies to set routing topologies, stackups, materials and design constraints for high-speed interfaces.

- Carry out post-layout SI analysis of critical channels: insertion and return loss, crosstalk, and eye and COM analysis using IBIS-AMI models.

- Design and optimise vias, breakouts, connector launches, and the transitions into optical engines and co-packaged components.

- Set PDN impedance targets, design decoupling strategies, and run DC drop and AC PDN analysis for high-current ASIC and FPGA rails.

- Support package, interposer and board co-simulation with the ASIC team to keep channel and power integrity sound end to end.

- Correlate simulation with lab measurements using TDRs, VNAs and oscilloscopes, and feed the results back into models and design rules.

- Evaluate and characterise PCB materials, connectors and cable assemblies with suppliers and fabricators.

- Build up our SI/PI methodology, model libraries and design guidelines so they can be reused across projects.

What We're Looking For 

Must-have 

- A degree in electronic engineering, physics or a related discipline, plus proven SI/PI experience on high-speed PCB and/or package designs.

- Proficiency with at least one major EM and circuit simulation suite, such as Ansys HFSS/SIwave, Keysight ADS or Cadence Sigrity/Clarity.

- Strong understanding of transmission line theory, S-parameters, crosstalk, loss mechanisms and channel compliance metrics such as eye diagrams and COM.

- Experience with IBIS and IBIS-AMI models for SerDes and memory interface simulation.

- Solid knowledge of PDN design, including impedance targeting, decoupling optimisation and DC IR drop analysis.

Strong preference for 

- Hands-on measurement with VNAs, TDRs and high-speed oscilloscopes, and the ability to correlate measurements with simulation.

- 56G/112G PAM4 channels, or PCIe Gen5/6 compliance.

- Package and interposer co-simulation, including chip-package-board analysis.

- Low-loss PCB materials and fabrication tolerances and their effect on high-speed performance.

- Scripting (Python, MATLAB) to automate simulation and post-processing.

About Lumai 

Lumai is the optical compute company building the next generation of AI infrastructure. Spun out of optics research at the University of Oxford in 2021, we compute with light instead of electrons. Our 3D optical technology carries out the matrix multiplications at the heart of AI inside beams of light travelling through free space, which lets it go beyond the limits of both silicon GPUs and integrated photonics.

In April 2026 we launched Iris Nova, the world's first optical computing system to run billion-parameter large language models in real time, using up to 90% less energy than conventional GPU-based systems. Iris Nova, the first server in the family, is now available for evaluation by hyperscalers, neoclouds, enterprises and research institutions. Aura and Tetra will follow.

Our work won the Falling Walls Award for Science Breakthrough of the Year 2025 and 'Best Overall Technology' at the OCP Future Technologies Symposium. We are headquartered in Oxford.

Why Lumai 

You'll work on a new kind of computer. Optical computing for AI has been promised for decades. We have a working system running real models, and the hard part left is taking it to volume.

Your work ships. We are moving from first product to volume production, so what you build this year goes into the servers our customers run.

You'll work across disciplines. Optical engineers, machine learning researchers, and hardware and software engineers solve problems together. You will learn things that don't appear on your job description.

The work matters beyond Lumai. AI's appetite for energy is one of the defining constraints of the next decade. Our mission is sustainable intelligence at global scale: AI that is faster, cheaper to run and far less power-hungry.

You'll join early. You'll have a real say in how we build the product, the team and the way we work.

title: GRC Pre-Sales Consultant / Solutions Engineer – EMEA
description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As a Solutions Engineer, you'll serve as a trusted technical voice, guiding customers toward clarity, feasibility, and alignment on the end-to-end solution. Because Vanta is the platform our customers rely on to build and run their GRC programmes, this is a natural next step for GRC professionals, programme managers, auditors, and compliance practitioners who want to apply their domain expertise in a strategic, customer-facing pre-sales role.

You’ll be an integral part of the Sales team, working to ensure technical fit and create innovative solutions for our customers. Your attention to detail, focused on customer needs, will ultimately improve retention and overall success.

This role will be based from our London office or Dublin office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.

GRC practitioners are especially encouraged to apply—whether you've managed GRC programmes in-house, audited them as an internal or external auditor, or helped customers meet their GRC programme needs at a GRC vendor, you'll bring exactly the customer empathy and domain fluency this role thrives on. 

What you’ll do as a Solutions Engineer at Vanta: 

- Serve as a strategic sales partner, owning the technical relationship with prospects and customers.

- Strategic Discovery and Deal Qualification: Partner with Account Executives to uncover technical, operational, and business pain points, validating use cases and aligning solutions to measurable customer impact and urgency.

- Secure the Solution Win and Alignment: Validate technical feasibility, drive clarity on success criteria, and guide stakeholders toward a shared vision for the end-to-end solution (The Solution Win: Desirable, Viable, and Aligned).

- High-Impact Technical Validation: Deliver tailored, narrative-driven demonstrations that showcase how Vanta solves the customer's specific problem, including how Vanta automates and operationalises their GRC programmes across frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA. Validate the feasibility of standard and semi-complex integrations and confirm alignment with customer environments, workflows, and architectures.

- Solution Strategy and Deal Shaping: Partner with the Account Executive to align the customer's success criteria with Vanta's unique strengths, proactively surface technical risks, and propose clear pathways to ensure focused deal progression and mutual success.

- Post-Sale Handoff and Continuity: Ensure a seamless transition to the post-sales team by creating and completing a handoff document that captures the finalised solution design, expectations, and any known risks or constraints.

- Cross-Functional Feedback: Act as a trusted technical voice, listening carefully to customers to provide structured market feedback to the Product team to prioritise functionality and drive sales opportunities.

- Support customers throughout their trial process with Vanta.

- Cultivate an environment of teamwork, openness, creativity, and continuous improvement.

How to be successful in this role: 

- Must be able to work in our London office 3 days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday).

- Have 5+ years of customer-facing, technical experience as a solutions engineer, sales engineer, GRC consultant, or equivalent customer-facing role, including previous B2B SaaS experience.

- Strategic Problem Solver: Possess deep technical proficiency to identify and validate technical, operational, and business pain points, driving clarity on solution requirements (Viable Solution Win).

- Exceptional Communicator: Exhibit outstanding communication, storytelling, and active listening abilities, capable of delivering tailored, high-impact demonstrations that reinforce the sales narrative (Command of the Message).

- Customer-Centric Advocate: Lead with empathy and curiosity, focusing on strategic discovery to uncover the why and urgency behind customer needs and tying every technical detail to measurable buyer impact (Desirable Solution Win).

- Collaborative Deal Shaper: Work in lockstep with Account Executives on deal strategy, proactively strengthening qualification and guiding stakeholders toward alignment on a clear delivery path (Aligned Solution Win).

- Have hands-on experience with cloud platforms: AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure & Operating Systems (Windows, MacOS, Linux) and cloud application architecture.

- Be detail-oriented and organised, with strong project management skills.

- Have general knowledge with a scripting language (Python, Ruby, Bash, and JavaScript) and a desire to expand those skills.

- Be familiar with REST API development and service integrations is a plus.

- Ideally have prior experience in the cybersecurity, GRC (governance, risk, and compliance), or audit space.

- Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n: 

- Industry-competitive salary and equity

- 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

- 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend

- Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

- Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office

- Pension matching

- 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time

- 8 company-paid holidays

- Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

- Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

#LI-hybrid

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply. 

About Vanta 

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

title: Software Engineering Internship - Healthcare (2027 start)
description:
Introduction 

Join our multidisciplinary team for a sandwich year placement in embedded software, where you’ll contribute to the development of innovative technologies for healthcare devices.

Candidates can start between May–September 2027.

There is no deadline for this role, as we recruit on a rolling basis. Once the position is filled, we will close the advert. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible .

What we do 

Each project we undertake is different, and at the cutting edge of technology. This means we can't talk about much of our ongoing work, but here are some examples of completed projects that we are excited to share:

- An emergency-use ventilator, developed in just over six weeks in response to the government’s Ventilator Challenge   

- A neurostimulation device allowing treatment to improve, or even restore, someone’s ability to walk   

- An autoinjector capable of delivering a wide range of drugs, while being intuitive to use and beautiful to look at     

What you'll be doing 

From day one, you’ll be part of our multidisciplinary medical development team, tackling real technical problems while receiving guidance and training from experienced engineers. You’ll gain access to designing and developing embedded software to a high standard. You will be part of a team developing technologies that can make a meaningful difference to people’s lives.

During your internship, you'll likely: 

- Design, develop, and test embedded software for complex medical systems used in diagnostic, surgical, implantable device, and drug-delivery applications.

- Contribute to a wide range of projects that span the full software development lifecycle.

- Collaborate with a multidisciplinary and supportive team, gaining exposure to systems involving electronics, optics, fluidics, robotics, and user-interface components.

- Work with industry best practices such as continuous integration, automated testing and analysis, and model-based systems engineering.

What You Can Bring 

The most important technical skill for this role is programming in C .

The following skills and experience are advantageous:

- Experience with other languages such as Rust, Python or C++

- Working in a team using version control (ideally Git) and peer code reviews

- Contributing to open-source software

- Unit testing or other verification techniques

- Experience developing embedded software

- Knowledge of electronics and controlling peripherals using interfaces such as UART/I2C/SPI

- Signal processing and/or control theory

- Data science and/or AI

Knowledge of biology or medical subjects is not a requirement, though you should be enthusiastic about applying your technical skills to this field of application.

Application requirements 

To apply for an internship role you must:

- Be currently studying towards a degree in a relevant field such as Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or Physics.

- Have experience programming in C.

- Be eligible to undertake a 12-month industrial placement as part of that course.

Your CV should include all your A Level (or equivalent) subjects and grades, where applicable, as well as university modules, coursework, projects or other experience that demonstrates your relevant skills.

A covering statement is welcome but is not required.

You understand that any false statement, misleading information, or material omission may render you liable to disqualification from the recruitment process, withdrawal of any offer of employment, or dismissal without notice if discovered following appointment. You acknowledge that the organisation reserves the right to verify the information supplied.

title: Graduate Fire Engineer 2027 Start - Manchester
description:
Graduate Fire Engineer 2027 Start – Manchester 

Manchester, UK 

Company Overview 

At Jensen Hughes, we’ve been helping make our world safe, secure and resilient since 1939. Today, our global network of experts works across fire protection engineering, security and risk-based fields, including
accessibility consulting, risk analysis, process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management and digital innovation.

Our engineers and consultants work together to solve complex safety and security challenges, helping our clients protect what matters most. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we continue toadvance the science of safety and make a meaningful difference to the communities we serve.

At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives, skills and talents they bring to our organisation.

Our Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organisation, supporting career development and creating opportunities to share experiences, build connections and learn from one another.

Job Overview 

Ready to start a career where your engineering skills can make a real difference?

We have an exciting opportunity for a Graduate Fire Engineer to join Jensen Hughes across the UK and Ireland and become part of our 2,000+ global employees working together to advance the science of safety every day.

These roles are open across our UK & Ireland offices. Please apply only to your preferred location. If you are open to more than one location, we will discuss this with you during the recruitment process.

Please note: to be considered for this role, you must have the right to work in the UK or Ireland. 

Why join Jensen Hughes and grow your career? 

Your career can go further than you think. 74% of our current Directors and Technical Directors in the UK & Ireland started their careers with us as graduates.

Be part of a leading fire consultancy. We have offices across Belgium, Finland, Italy, Denmark and the UK & Ireland. Our reputation for innovative, design-focused solutions has made us the consultant of choice for many of Europe’s leading property clients.

Learn from experienced engineers. As a Graduate Fire Engineer, you will be an integral part of a dynamic design team. Working alongside experienced Engineers, you will receive ongoing technical support to build your knowledge and experience across fire engineering projects.

Build your career in a supportive environment. You’ll have the opportunity to develop your career within a supportive and diverse team where we strive to do the right thing for our people, clients and communities.

Take responsibility early. You will be given early responsibility and the opportunity to progress rapidly. Jensen Hughes encourages all Engineers to work towards chartered status through the Institute of Fire Engineers, providing help and support throughout the process.

What will you be working on? 

As a Graduate Fire Engineer, you’ll work on a variety of exciting projects, helping to develop innovative fire engineering solutions for new and existing buildings.

Your work will include:

- Carrying out fire engineering analysis on a
range of new and existing building projects.

- Working across a diverse range of buildings,
including high-rise office buildings, large retail complexes and airport
developments, each presenting its own unique challenges.

- Analysing fire growth, means of escape,
structural fire resistance and smoke control using a variety of methods,
including computer modelling software such as Computational Fluid Dynamics.

- Preparing technical reports and liaising with
clients, including some of the largest building developers in the country.

Requirements and Qualifications 

To set you up for success in the role, you’ll need:

- Right to work in the UK or Ireland.

- A Master’s degree, achieved within the last two
years or expected, in Fire Engineering, Mechanical Engineering,
Aerospace/Aeronautical Engineering, or Physics.

- Exceptional written and verbal communication
skills in English.

- Additional qualifications and experience

The following would also help you succeed in the role: 

- A team player who can work effectively with
colleagues at all levels.

- Excellent communication and time management
skills.

- Enthusiasm to innovate.

- A second European language is an advantage but
not essential.

We’ve successfully welcomed Graduate Fire Engineers from a variety of STEM Master’s backgrounds, including Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace/Aeronautical Engineering and Physics. Many of these individuals have gone on to build outstanding careers with us.

If you’re committed to pursuing a career in Fire Engineering and have a transferable STEM Master’s degree, we’d love to hear from you. Tell us why you’re ready to start your career with Jensen Hughes.

Graduate Development Programme 

Starting your career is about more than your first role, it’s about building the foundations for your future.

Our Graduate Development Programme gives you hands-on project experience, mentorship and support as you work towards professional accreditation. Over two years, you’ll gain experience across fire engineering and related disciplines, helping you build the knowledge and skills needed for a successful and impactful career.

You’ll also have the opportunity to undertake Continuing Professional Development (CPD) as you progress through the programme, helping you continue to develop your technical knowledge and professional skills. We provide support and encouragement for Engineers working towards Chartered Engineer status , helping you work towards this important professional milestone as you build your career with Jensen Hughes.

Sustainability in Fire Engineering 

At Jensen Hughes, fire safety and sustainability go hand in hand.

In the UK, we support the design of safe, energy-efficient and sustainable buildings that meet BREEAM standards and align with net-zero goals. As a graduate, you’ll play a role in delivering solutions that protect people while helping to create a more sustainable built environment.

Our People Are Our Greatest Asset 

At Jensen Hughes, we know that our people are the foundation of our success. To attract and retain the best talent, we offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, work-life balance, and professional growth.

Our UK&I Benefits Include: 

- Private medical insurance

- 33 days of holiday(including
bank holidays) with an additional day after 3 years

- Industry-leading contributory pension scheme

- 4x life assurance

- Income protection scheme

- Discretionary bonus scheme

- Employee assistance programme

- Enhanced parental-related pay

- Recognition and reward programmers to celebrate
team efforts

- Access to extensive technical training and
resources

Supporting Your Work-Life Balance: 

We understand the importance of flexibility and balance. We're happy to discuss hybrid, part-time, and flexible working arrangements to suit both you and the business. For certain teams, this may include an early Friday finish at 3 pm once contracted hours and client deadlines are met. We also offer:

- Flexible working hours and patterns

- Flexible holiday use over Christmas/New Year

- Enhanced holiday entitlement after three years

- The option to carry over up to five unused
holiday days into the next year (subject to discussion and approval)

A Commitment to Continuous Improvement 

Our benefits represent a meaningful investment in both our people and the future of Jensen Hughes. We regularly review our benefits programme to ensure it aligns with statutory requirements, market trends, and the needs of our team. Any modifications will be carefully considered to support our employees and the company’s long-term goals.

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: privacy is a fundamental human right . Since then, we’ve built the world’s largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar—tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. The Proton Drive Desktop Team 

Proton Drive is our secure, private cloud storage and collaborative editing suite, with clients on Windows, Mac, iOS, Android, and Web. One platform is missing: Linux. You will build it from scratch. This is a greenfield project with high visibility inside Proton and across the open-source community — our entire client codebase is published under an open-source license, and this will be the first public example of how to build a native application on top of the Proton Drive SDK. You will work closely with our Windows and Mac engineers to ensure feature parity, and you will contribute to our platform-agnostic SDK and CLI tooling as the Linux surface area demands it. - Git, CI/CD pipelines

- Integrate deeply with Linux-specific system components, including the filesystem layer for our file synchronization engine.

- Contribute to our platform-agnostic SDK and CLI tooling to ensure Linux features are properly exposed for scripting and cross-client use.

- Build and maintain cross-client automated and end-to-end tests in collaboration with Windows and Mac engineers.

- Define and implement application telemetry to support performance analysis, debugging, and customer support.

description:

For more information, visit WPP.com .

A Hybrid working model 

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. 

What does a Global Hub Operations Director do at WPP Production? 

Lead the operational performance and development of Studio A’s global production hub network. The role sets a consistent operating standard across locations, turns demand into credible capacity plans, and ensures hubs can deliver secure, high quality work at the service levels and economics agreed with the client. It connects Hub Operations Leads, delivery and capability leaders, Geo teams, Commercial, Talent, HR, Finance, Technology and Facilities so that decisions on capacity, location, cost and risk are made with one view of the facts.

The Director leads through the Hub Operations Leads and the global operating cadence. They own the hub operating model and its execution, while partnering with the relevant functional and commercial owners on decisions outside hub operations.

Reporting lines and key stakeholders: 

- Reports to the Global Operations Director. Manages and develops the Hub Operations Leads across the global network, with clear local accountabilities and escalation routes.

- Covers centralised production hubs and the resources, infrastructure, controls and services required to support Worldwide and Geo demand, including permanent and flexible capacity.

- Works in a matrix with Heads of Delivery, capability SMEs, Geo and client operations, Commercial, Talent, HR, Finance, Security, Technology and Facilities. Local employment, technical craft and client commercial approval remain with their designated owners.

Key Responsibilities:

Global hub strategy and governance

- Set the hub operating model, decision rights and governance for shared capacity, including how Worldwide and Geo demand is prioritised, allocated and escalated when requirements conflict.

- Maintain a practical Hub Playbook covering planning, onboarding, access and security, local compliance, service management, financial controls, business continuity and location specific requirements. Audit adoption and close gaps.

- Assess the hub footprint against demand, capability, resilience, cost, security and talent availability. Develop business cases and transition plans for expansion, consolidation or changes in the mix of work across locations.

- Run a regular hub leadership cadence, with consistent status reporting, decisions, actions and cross hub learning. Chair operational reviews and escalate material trade offs promptly.

Capacity, workforce and delivery

- Translate demand forecasts, Workshop peaks and capability plans into a rolling view of capacity by hub, skill, language, security classification and employment type. Test scenarios for changes in volume, complexity, timing and location.

- Work with Delivery, SMEs and Geo leaders to allocate shared resources, manage utilisation and productivity, protect service levels and balance work across hubs. Identify bottlenecks early and agree actions rather than relying on local workarounds.

- Set requirements for permanent and flexible staffing with Talent and HR; oversee readiness, onboarding, training and exit planning for large scale programmes and demand changes. Ensure employment classification and local legal or tax questions go to the accountable specialists.

- Lead operational readiness for Workshops and other surges, including space, technology, security, access, staffing, shifts, supplier support and contingency capacity.

- Own the operational response to a hub disruption. Keep tested continuity and recovery plans, including transfer options, cross training, access dependencies and client approvals where required.

Commercial performance and controls

- Provide the operational data and discipline needed to run the commercial model as agreed: retained capacity, complexity based deliverables and approved time and materials exceptions. Ensure work is coded and measured consistently so actual demand, effort and cost can be compared with the model.

- Partner with Commercial and Finance on forecast accuracy, capacity pool economics, the minimum spend commitment, margin, scope changes, rush requests and Workshop demand. Identify the operational causes of variance and propose corrective actions; do not change prices or commitments without the agreed approval route.

- Supply a reliable monthly operational pack covering volumes and complexity, capacity and utilisation, forecast accuracy, service levels, quality, revisions and exceptions. Support quarterly commercial reviews of spend, margin, demand, savings and capacity risks, and the annual review of unit prices, cost adjustment, efficiency commitment and baseline capacity.

- Drive measurable productivity and the contracted efficiency commitment through improved planning, workflow, automation and location mix while protecting quality, security and sustainable capacity. Validate savings with Finance and avoid double counting.

- Ensure hub financial procedures, hiring controls, approved rates, procurement and contractor processes are followed. Surface non compliant practices and remediate them with the accountable teams.

Systems, data and improvement

- Define the operational requirements and adoption plan for the resource management platform, including estimates, staffing plans, scenario planning, schedules, timesheets, PTO and overtime, capacity reporting and relevant integrations.

- Set data definitions, ownership and quality controls across hubs so leadership can trust capacity, productivity, delivery and cost reporting. Use the data to diagnose recurring constraints and measure whether interventions work.

- Partner with Technology and process owners on rollout of production tools, language capacity planning, freelancer management and workflow improvements. Ensure local teams are trained and changes are embedded.

People, partnerships and risk

- Lead, coach and assess Hub Operations Leads. Build an integrated leadership team with clear expectations, succession cover and consistent management standards across locations.

- Build trusted relationships with senior Delivery, Geo, capability and client operations stakeholders. Make trade offs visible, resolve competing priorities and communicate decisions with clarity.

- Oversee hub risks relating to security, confidentiality, health and safety, infrastructure, service continuity and local compliance. Maintain a visible risk and action log, with owners and deadlines, and escalate issues that need executive decisions.

Measures of success

- Reliable delivery against agreed service levels, quality and security requirements across the hub network.

- Capacity and forecast accuracy by pool, with healthy utilisation, controlled overtime and a clear response to peaks and gaps.

- Commercial performance supported by trusted operational data, early variance management and validated efficiency gains.

- Consistent controls and operating standards, evidenced through reviews, audit actions and business continuity readiness.

- Effective Hub Operations Leads, clear stakeholder confidence and decisions made at the right level.

Requirements 

- Senior operations leadership in a complex, multi location production, agency, shared services or comparable environment, including management through local leaders and matrix teams.

- Strong command of capacity planning, workforce mix, service performance, financial controls and commercially consequential operational decisions.

- Ability to turn incomplete demand and cost data into practical scenarios, recommendations and executive decisions. Confident with metrics and able to challenge assumptions.

- Experience of scaling or reshaping hub operations, leading change in systems and processes, and managing security and continuity requirements.

- Direct, collaborative leadership; sound judgement under pressure; strong stakeholder management across cultures and functions; concise written and verbal communication.
